objects.title: Welcome to the Show 🎭
objects.text:
This world is rather peculiar. People insist it runs on laws, logic, governments, economies, and all those wonderfully boring things. They are adorable for believing that. The truth is far simpler.

Every great world needs a story, A good story! A story needs heroes who rise when everyone else falls. Villains who refuse to stay buried. Heated rivalries. Oh, the drama!

And, of course, it needs someone worth watching. For most people, life passes quietly. They are born, they grow, they worry over small things, they dream small dreams, and eventually die without accomplishing anything meaningful with their lives.

How terribly, terribly dull... People who live like worms.

But then there are people like you. People with a Role. People who are worth watching.

Somewhere along the way, whether through brilliance, stupidity, tragedy, determination, or sheer rotten luck...

You became interesting. Now the Role sleeping inside you has begun to stir.

It will offer you power, certainly. Strange power. Beautiful power. Horrible power. The sort that changes your body, your life, your relationships and ofcourse your story!

Try not to disappoint. The lights are up.

The audience is waiting.

And you, my dear, have finally been cast.

objects.title: Urban Jungle
objects.text: You grew up surrounded by concrete, traffic, crowded streets, and a thousand lives brushing past yours without ever slowing down. There was always somewhere to go, something to buy, someone to avoid, and some new noise leaking through the walls at night. The city life never truly sleeps...

objects.title: Countryside
objects.text: Rolling fields, quiet roads and neighbours who somehow knew your business before you did. Life moved at its own comfortable pace, where familiar faces are a constant and nature was never more than a short walk away. It may lack the excitement of great cities, but it does offer a sense of peace.

objects.title: Coastal Haven
objects.text: You grew up near the sea. Salt in the air, damp winds, gulls overhead, fishing boats, crowded beaches, stormy evenings, and the distant sound of waves becoming part of the background noise of life. There is a restlessness to this life, Those who grow up alongside the sea dream up future of equal proportions.

objects.title: Mountain Life
objects.text: You grew up surrounded by steep roads, cold fog, thin air, and landscapes that made you feel very small. Getting anywhere took effort and weather could change plans without warning. Living amongst the mountains teaches patience as much as resilience, You will be one tough cookie to break.

rows.title: Where It All Began
rows.titleText:
“A person may leave their hometown, but their hometown will never leave them"

Every actor is shaped by their first set. The streets you wandered, the walls you lived within, the horizon you measured yourself against... all of it leaves a mark.

So tell me, where did your story begin?

objects.title: Loving
objects.text: Your family was not perfect, but they were present. They celebrated your successes, worried when you were hurt, and made it clear that you had people in your corner no matter how badly life went. Home was somewhere you could return to when the rest of the world became unbearable.

objects.title: Demanding
objects.text: Your family believed in standards. Good grades, proper behaviour, a respectable future, and no embarrassing detours along the way. They may have loved you deeply, but affection and praise needed to be earned and not to mention the constant expectation that you should be doing better.

objects.title: Neglectful
objects.text: Your family was there... at least technically, but there was always a gap between you and them. Whether occupied by work, their own struggles or simple neglect, they seldom noticed the person you were becoming. You learned to handle problems alone because nobody bothered to help you out.

objects.title: Unstable
objects.text: Nothing at home stayed calm for long. Arguments could erupt instantly, plans changed without warning, broken spirits, Some days were warm and happy, others had parents fighting each other. Predictability was a luxury your household could never quite afford. You learned to find humour wherever you could.

objects.title: Overprotective
objects.text: Your family loved you fiercely, perhaps to the point of suffocation. They worried about every risk, questioned every friend, and often made decisions on your behalf because they believed they knew what was best. Their concern may have come from genuine love, but it still left little room for you to become independent.

objects.title: Hostile
objects.text: There was no safety in your home, only the constant noise of fighting and broken dishes. Perhaps your parents resented you, blamed you for their own failures or were plain idiots, outcome was same. No child should grow up believing they deserve to be hated... yet somehow, you did.

objects.title: Struggling
objects.text: Your family genuinely loved you, and you never doubted that. Unfortunately, love does not magically solve debt, addiction, illness or poor decisions. They tried their best with what they had. Looking back, you find it difficult to resent them... even if they gave you plenty of reasons to do so.

objects.title: Alone
objects.text: Whether through abandonment, loss, estrangement or circumstances that beyond your control, you did not have a stable family to fall back on. You may have had people who cared for you along the way, but no one was guaranteed to stay. You learned that if someone was going to save you... it has to be yourself.

rows.title: Family Atmosphere
rows.titleText:
“Before you had a Role, before powers and spotlights and all the delightful disasters to come, there was home"

Or at least, the place you were expected to call home...

whether they were good or not, Your family does determine what sort of person you end up becoming.

So then, what sort of family did you grow up with?

objects.title: Rugged
objects.text:
Ahh, splendid! A face carved by life itself. Sharp edges, messy hair, weathered charm, perhaps a scar or two.

There is nothing polished about you, and that's precisely the appeal. You may look like you've living on the street.. yet somehow everyone agrees it only makes you so much hotter.

objects.title: Cute
objects.text: Small features, youthful charm, bright expressions and an adorable face... an utterly dangerous combo. Audiences are remarkably willing to forgive the unforgivable if the culprit is adorable enough. Never underestimate the destructive potential of someone everyone wants to protect.

objects.title: Intimidating
objects.text: A naturally imposing appearance with sharp features, piercing eyes and a presence that seems larger than life. You don't need to scowl to make people think twice before approaching, your very presence does most of the work. Strangers are quick to assume you're dangerous or simply someone not worth provoking.

objects.title: Elegant
objects.text: A picture-perfect presence. Soft, refined features, graceful posture and eyes that naturally draw attention without demanding it. Whether dressed for a gala or simply walking down the street, you carry yourself with an effortless elegance that many would spend a lifetime chasing.

objects.title: Plain
objects.text:
Perfectly ordinary. Not forgettable, mind you.

And yet... there is something wonderfully theatrical about an ordinary person standing at the center of an extraordinary story. They rarely expect greatness, which makes it all the more satisfying when you shatter every expectation they had.

objects.title: Sophisticated
objects.text: There is an unmistakable sense of experience about you. Confident eyes, relaxed posture and subtle expressions make it seem as though very little in life still surprises you. Your features carry a quiet maturity and difficult to get a read on. People naturally assume you know more than you let on

objects.title: Captivating
objects.text:
Some people are attractive. You are distracting.

An almost unfair level of beauty. Perfect symmetry, mesmerizing eyes and features that seem almost sculpted rather than born. Whether through admiration, infatuation or simple distraction, your appearance has a habit of lowering people's guard.

objects.title: Androgynous
objects.text: Your features sit beautifully outside easy assumptions. Soft and sharp in equal measure, you can look entirely different depending on your clothes, expression or the angle from which someone sees you. People are often drawn in by the uncertainty, then become oddly invested in deciding what they think you are.

rows.title: Your Appearance
rows.titleText:
"They say never judge a book by its cover. A charming little lie told by people with unfortunate covers."

Fortunately, you needn't worry. Those destined for a Role are never truly unpleasant to look at.

Beauty comes in many forms, and the audience is remarkably forgiving when someone is interesting.

Now then... let's decide what sort of face they'll remember

objects.title: Compassionate
objects.text: You naturally care about the people around you. Whether they are friends or complete strangers, you find it difficult to ignore someone in need. You may not always have the strength to help, but you almost always wish you could. Empathy comes easily to you, sometimes to your own detriment.

objects.title: Ambitious
objects.text: You have never been comfortable with simply existing. There is always something greater to reach for. You can enjoy what you have, certainly, but some restless part of you is already looking toward the next achievement. You set impossibly high expectations for yourself and somehow still manage to achieve them.

objects.title: Proud
objects.text: You have a strong sense of your own worth. Being underestimated, pitied or spoken down to can get under your skin far more than you would like to admit. If someone tells you there is only one acceptable path, your first thought is usually to find the nearest fence and climb over it to prove them wrong.

objects.title: Curious
objects.text: You have an insatiable desire to understand the world around you. Mysteries draw you in, strange ideas keep you awake at night, and every answer somehow creates three more questions. While others are content accepting things as they are, you cannot help wondering what lies just beyond the next door...

objects.title: Playful
objects.text: You have a talent for finding amusement in bad situations and a stubborn ability to keep moving after things go wrong. Worrying about tomorrow feels like a dumb way to ruin today. You enjoy making people laugh, poking fun at friends, and turning even the dullest conversation into something memorable.

objects.title: Impulsive
objects.text: You do as you feel. When you are angry, it shows. When you are excited, everyone nearby will know. There is very little distance between your emotions and your choices, which can make you reckless, sincere, overwhelming, or strangely refreshing in a world full of people lying to each other.

objects.title: Alluring
objects.text: People have always fascinated you. You enjoy conversation, attention and the subtle dance of personalities colliding with one another. Whether through wit, confidence, or charm, you have a habit of drawing people closer, You understand people better than they understand themselves

objects.title: Reserved
objects.text: Not everyone enjoys being the centre of attention, and you are perfectly content with that. You tend to be quiet around strangers, speaking only when you feel comfortable. Friends know there is far more to you than first impressions suggest, but earning that side of you takes patience and your trust.

rows.title: Your Personality
rows.titleText:
"This is where the real casting begins."

Strip away the costumes. Silence the applause. Let the audience leave.

When there is nobody left to impress and no expectations left to satisfy...

When nobody is watching, who are you?

objects.title: Physical Pursuits
objects.text: Whether it was football, martial arts, gymnastics, dance, swimming, rock climbing, or simply any activity that demanded movement, your body always seemed eager to cooperate. You had a natural feel for strength, speed and coordination, whether that meant outrunning everyone at school, learning a fighting stance after seeing it once, lifting more than people expected, or keeping your balance in situations where most people would already be kissing the floor.

objects.title: Games of the Mind
objects.text: You were drawn toward hobbies where victory came from planning rather than muscle. Strategy games, chess, card games, programming, escape rooms, deduction games, tabletop games, or anything where reading the situation gave you an advantage. You were good at noticing patterns, remembering details, predicting what someone might do next, and finding a way around a problem instead of charging through it. Not every battle is fought with fists after all.

objects.title: Creative Arts
objects.text: Whether through drawing, music, writing, photography, fashion, filmmaking, cosplay, crafts or any other artistic pursuit, you possessed an imagination that refused to stay locked inside your own head. Creating something that never existed before brought a strange kind of satisfaction. You had an eye for style, mood, detail and presentation, whether you preferred sketching quietly for hours or put a performance nobody could try to ignore.

objects.title: Hands-On Work
objects.text: You had a knack for making yourself useful. Cooking, sewing, repairing electronics, fixing bikes, working with tools, gardening, building small projects, restoring old things or taking something apart just to understand how it worked. You had the patience to keep trying when others gave up halfway through. There was always something satisfying about taking a mess, a broken object, or a pile of separate parts and leaving it better than you first found it.

rows.title: Natural Talents
rows.titleText:
"Role does not appear from nowhere, darling. It gives foreshadowing first!"

Long before your Role ever stirred, it left little breadcrumbs behind. Strange little talents.

Skills you picked up far too quickly. Hobbies that seemed to choose you rather than the other way around.

What were you always strangely good at?

objects.title: Fierce Passion
objects.text: When something earns your heart, it earns all of it. A friend, a promise or even a grudge... once you've decided it matters, there is very little that can convince you to let it go. You don't hide your emotions behind a calm face, you celebrate it loudly and throw yourself into your task without a second thought. Nobody can ever accuse you of being half-hearted.

objects.title: Upilfter
objects.text: People are better when they are around you. Being around you makes others want to stand taller. You remind them that failure is not the end of their story, that being weak today does not mean they will remain weak forever. You see more in people than they often see in themselves. They want to become someone worthy of the faith you place in them.

objects.title: Impossible will
objects.text: Giving up has never come naturally to you. When you set your mind on something, you become difficult to reason with. You can be exhausted, bruised, frightened or completely outmatched, and somehow you'll still take another step forward. There is a stubbornness to you that borders on crazy, If you cannot run, you will walk. If you cannot walk, then you will crawl.

objects.title: Ingenious
objects.text: When a situation becomes complicated, people start looking toward you because you are the person who notices what everyone else missed. There is a particular thrill in watching you work. The audience sees the same impossible situation everyone else sees, then watches you pull it apart piece by piece until the path forward becomes visible.

objects.title: Loose canon
objects.text: You have the nerve to say what everyone else is thinking, and often several things nobody should have said at all.. Everything about you carries that same audacity. The way you walk into danger, the way you refuse to be intimidated. You have a talent for throwing people off balance because nobody is ever quite sure whether you are fearless or brilliant, or both.

objects.title: Defiant Freedom
objects.text: You cannot live by rules you do not believe in. You have a strong sense of what you can accept and what you cannot, and once that line is crossed, you are willing to make enemies over it. There is something powerful about a person who stays true to their ideals. You do not need permission to act according to your ideals. You only need a reason to.

objects.title: Dramatic Presence
objects.text: You have a natural sense for making an impression. You have a way of taking control of a room whether through confidence, conviction or sheer force of personality, attention naturally drifts toward you whenever you begin to speak. When something important is happening, you want to be at the centre of it and give people something worth remembering.

objects.title: Genuine
objects.text: People know where they stand with you because you mean what you say and say what you mean. There is a sincerity to the way you live that catches others off guard. In a world full of people trying to appear larger than life, you are refreshingly honest about who you are. People are pulled towards that sincerity and often see themselves within you.

rows.title: Your Finest Quality
rows.titleText:
"First impressions matter. Not because they're accurate. Good heavens, no. People are terrible at judging character."

A Role may make you powerful, but power alone does not make a star.

People need a reason to look at you and root for you, A reason to defend your shortcomings.

Everyone has something admirable about them. Even you.

What is your greatest virtue?

objects.title: Coward
objects.text: You know exactly how dangerous the world can be, and you have no intention of dying for someone else's ideals. When everything falls apart, your first instinct is survival. You'll make excuses, look for another way, hide behind stronger people, or simply run before things become impossible. You hate yourself for it afterwards... but in the moment, You are a coward.

objects.title: Naive
objects.text: You want to believe people are better than they are. Even after betrayal, part of you keeps searching for the kinder explanation. You forgive too easily, trust too quickly, and convince yourself that everyone deserves another chance are just misunderstood. Sometimes you're right.. other times you hand another knife to the person who stabbed you yesterday.

objects.title: Self-Righteous
objects.text: You have strong beliefs, and you are not afraid to act on them. The problem is that you can become convinced that your way is the only moral way. You judge people harshly for compromises you would never accept, dismiss perspectives that challenge your certainty, and may hurt others while telling yourself it was necessary for the greater good.

objects.title: Detached
objects.text: You keep people at a distance because caring gives them the power to hurt you. You may care deeply, but people rarely know it because you struggle to let them in. You avoid asking for help, hide pain behind indifference, and can become distant whenever someone gets too close. When things become too emotional, you find a reason to disappear.

objects.title: Grudge
objects.text:
You do not let things go. Betrayal, humiliation, loss, disrespect, injustice... There is a line people should not cross with you. Once they do, forgiveness becomes almost impossible. You may tell yourself it is about justice or about protecting others.

Deep down, you are fully aware that's just a lie. You only care that they suffer.

objects.title: Controlling
objects.text: You struggle to leave important things in other people’s hands. You need to know what is happening, who is involved, what the plan is, and how it will end. Trusting others feels like a gamble you cannot afford to take. You can become so focused on preventing disaster that you forget other people deserve the freedom to make their own choices and cage them.

objects.title: Self-Sacrificing
objects.text: Helping others comes naturally. Helping yourself doesn't.. You are willing to pay almost any price to help other. Your health, safety, relationships, reputation, future... all of it becomes negotiable. Your loved ones will watch you slowly destroy yourself in the name of helping others, convinced that everyone else deserves happiness at their own cost.

objects.title: Devoted
objects.text: There is someone, or something, you have built too much of yourself around. Their happiness matters more than your own. You may call it love, loyalty, admiration, gratitude, or simply knowing where you belong. The name does not change the problem. You have become so focused on supporting someone else that you struggle to imagine yourself without them.

rows.title: Your Fatal Flaw
rows.titleText:
"Perfection is unbearably dull."

What makes a story worth following is not watching someone succeed without effort, Its to watch them succeed and overcome their demons.

Do remember flaws have to make sense with your finest quality, it can warp it but never cancel it outright.

What is your greatest flaw?

objects.title: Stood your ground
objects.text: Someone stronger than you had power over the situation. A bully, an abuser, a gang, an authority figure, someone with influence or simply more people. You knew you would lose badly. But you refused to back down. Perhaps you were defending yourself or were simply tired of being treated as a pushover. Whatever the reason, you made your choice: you looked at something bigger than you and said no.

objects.title: You Took the Hit
objects.text: When something went wrong, you had the chance to protect yourself. Instead, you put yourself between danger and someone else. It may have been physical danger, public humiliation, or punishment. They could have been family, a friend, someone you loved, or a stranger you barely knew. The reason almost does not matter. You saw someone about to be hurt, and your body moved before you could think.

objects.title: Great loss
objects.text: Something outside your control tore through your life and left it hollow afterwards. Something important was lost, ruined, exposed, or taken away while you were powerless to stop it. It could have been a person, a relationship, your home, your reputation, your future, Your wealth or something you worked hard for. You were forced to watch it slip away while being completely powerless to stop it from happening.

objects.title: Lucky Survivor
objects.text: Something happened that should have ended much worse than it did. An accident, a disaster, an attack, a dangerous situation, or simply a moment where everything went wrong at once. Nobody had any reason to believe you would make it through. But you did. Maybe you planned it or maybe luck dragged you out by the collar. But point is when everything went wrong, you still came out the other side.

objects.title: Terrible Choice
objects.text: There was a moment when you acted without thinking, or thought about it and did it anyway. You were desperate, angry, scared, bored, trying to prove something, trying to fix something, or simply convinced that nothing could go wrong. You made a choice that had consequences far bigger than you expected. Your arrogance ruined things for others.

objects.title: You took charge
objects.text:
For a long time, your life had been going nowhere. Not ruined beyond repair, not dramatic enough for anyone to rush in and save you, just stuck in a hopeless cycle. Then you stopped waiting for life to improve on its own.

You chose something worth moving toward. It could have been a goal, a person, a promise, a skill or a dream you had buried long ago.

objects.title: You Snapped
objects.text: You had been holding things together for a long time. Keeping quiet, staying polite, swallowing anger, pretending something did not hurt as much as it did. People assumed you could handle it because you always had before. But one day.. you had enough and finally snapped. You made a scene, broke down, fought back, you refused to get walked over anymore.

objects.title: Enemy of Ordinary
objects.text: There was something about your life that you simply could not accept anymore. Nothing particular.. just the whole monotonous routine of it. The same places, the same people, the same expectations.. While everyone else was content sitting behind the bars, you were biting at them. You started acting out, taking risks, chasing trouble, making reckless decisions to feel alive.

rows.title: The Moment You Became Interesting
rows.titleText:
"This was the day your quiet little life wandered onto my stage. Congratulations."

For most of your life, you were perfectly ordinary. You went where you were meant to go, worried about the things people worry about, and stayed safe.

Then something happened.. Perhaps you chose it. Perhaps it chose you.

Either way, for one brief moment, you stopped being another face in the crowd.

That was when the world began paying attention.

objects.title: Joy
objects.text: For once, life felt full. You were celebrating, laughing, reunited with someone, achieving something you had wanted for years, or simply surrounded by people who made you feel safe. The happiness rose so quickly that you could not keep it contained, so it burst out from you. The world bloomed around you. Plants pushed through concrete. Dead grass turned green. Cracks filled with flowers and leaves.

objects.title: Anger
objects.text: Someone had pushed you too far. Perhaps they hurt someone you cared about. Perhaps they humiliated you, cornered you, or kept pressing at a wound they had no right to touch. Your anger rose so quickly that you felt burning hot in your chest. You knew that you wanted them gone. Then the world around you answered. A burst of fire erupted from your body and tore through the space around you.

objects.title: Fear
objects.text: Something was coming for you. You could see it, feel it closing in. You knew that fighting was impossible. Every instinct begged you to run, to get away, to put as much distance between yourself and danger as humanly possible. So you ran. Your legs moved faster than your mind could follow. Cars, walls, crowds, entire blocks blurred past in seconds. By the time you realised what had happened, you were standing far far away.

objects.title: Frustration
objects.text: Nothing was working. You had tried explaining, arguing, fixing, waiting, thinking it through, and somehow the situation only became worse. There were too many moving parts refusing to behave the way they should. You needed everything to just move. and it did. Chairs scraped across the floor. Doors slammed open. Papers tore free from desks and spiraled through the air. Loose objects lifted, spun, and crashed into walls

objects.title: grief
objects.text:
Something had been taken from you, and the pain of it became too much to carry quietly. You wanted the world to understand what had happened. You wanted everything around you to feel as empty as you did.

Then the temperature started dropping. Frost spread across the ground from beneath your feet. The place around you became cold as ice climbed across walls and pavement, as if mourning your pain.

objects.title: Shame
objects.text: You had been seen at your worst. Maybe you failed when people depended on you. Maybe you were caught lying. Maybe somebody exposed something ugly or deeply personal about you. You wanted the them to stop seeing you, and world complied. Bulbs burst overhead. Light sources flickered once and died. Darkness flooded the space quickly, Somewhere inside that blackness, you were gone.

objects.title: Euphoria
objects.text: You had done it. Against all odds, against common sense, against everyone who didn't believe in you. You somehow won. The rush hit you all at once. Your heart pounded. You laughed, shouted, still trying to understand how you had actually pulled it off. The pressure in the air changed, lifting everything around you into a slow, weightless orbit. For a few seconds, gravity itself seemed caught up in your victory.

objects.title: Disgust
objects.text: Something about them made your skin crawl, their very presence made your stomach turn. A lie so vile you wanted to scrub it from existence. You wanted them away from you. The world began rejecting it with you. Metal bloomed with rust. Food blackened. Paint blistered from the walls. Flowers wilted where they stood. Anything close to the source of your disgust aged, decayed or fell apart with impossible speed.

rows.title: The First Break
rows.titleText:
"You did not wake up one morning with powers and a neat little explanation waiting beside your bed."

No.. Something happened, something pressed against the part of you that could not tolerate being powerless any longer. There was pressure in your chest. A feeling that you had to act, had to win, had to escape, had to protect yourself, had to make someone understand.

But the ordinary was no longer enough, no you needed more, You needed world to bend in your favor..

And it did.

objects.title: You Hurt Someone
objects.text: Whether you meant to or not, someone got caught in the middle of your awakening. Maybe they were the very reason your emotions boiled over. Maybe they were trying to help. Maybe they simply happened to be standing in the wrong place at the worst possible moment. You hurt them.

objects.title: You Made a Scene
objects.text: Your awakening did not stop at you. It tore through the place around you and left everyone nearby with a very good reason to remember the day. Whatever your power was, it made its entrance with all the subtlety of a building collapsing. Congratulations. You have made quite an entrance indeed.

objects.title: They Fear You
objects.text: The power itself was bad enough. The look on the faces of the people you loved made it worse. For a few seconds, they did not see their child, sibling, friend, or partner in you, They saw you as a monster. This hurts, doesn’t it? A stranger’s fear is easy to ignore. Fear from home stings your soul.

objects.title: Nothing Happened
objects.text: By some miracle, your awakening passed without leaving a body on the floor. Maybe you were alone. Maybe the power faded before it could do any real harm. Your awakening came and went like a strange dream. Just you and your new powers now. Frankly, that's rather disappointing.

objects.title: You Were Taken in
objects.text: It took remarkably little time for someone to notice. Perhaps the police were called, maybe some government office or an investigator. You spent the following hours, or days, explaining an event you barely understood yourself. A difficult conversation, considering half the room distrusted you.

objects.title: Addiction
objects.text: You remembered what it felt like. The power felt good. For one moment, the world listened to you. You were stronger, stranger, more alive than you had ever been. Even if the awakening went badly, even if you hurt someone or terrified yourself, part of you wants to feel it again, to feel strong again.

objects.title: Life Ruined
objects.text: Maybe the place was damaged beyond repair. Maybe your workplace fired you. Maybe your landlord refused to let you return out of fear. The aftermath made it impossible to return to your life. A dramatic beginning, certainly. Though I do hope you enjoyed having a stable life while it lasted.

objects.title: Dissociation
objects.text: The awakening ends, but you do not feel like yourself afterwards. You wanted to go home, sit beside someone you trusted, and admit that you were terrified. You wanted somebody to say they understood... but how could they? They can't understood you, They can never understand you.

rows.title: The Immediate Consequence
rows.titleText:
"Power is rarely subtle the first time it appears. "

You were frightened, angry, grieving, ecstatic, completely overwhelmed... hardly the ideal state to discover you can perform supernatural feats.

Needless to say, things got messy... Okay that's a lie, It got worse.

So, when the dust settled, what had you done?

objects.title: Bury it
objects.text: You want this gone. You refuse to test the power. You pretend the incident never happened and try to force yourself back into ordinary life. A charming idea. Completely hopeless, of course. A Role once awakened cannot be put back to sleep. The power will keep surfacing whether you like it or not.

objects.title: Study It
objects.text: The power frightened you, but ignorance frightened you more. You found somewhere private and began testing it carefully. You used it a little, watched what happened, wrote things down, tried again. There is a difference between holding a weapon and knowing how to use one after all.

objects.title: Indulge It
objects.text: You are done pretending this is not extraordinary. Something impossible happened to you, and rather than hiding from it, you let it become part of your life. Maybe you enjoy the attention. Maybe you enjoy the power. Whatever the reason, you have accepted the spotlight and you look rather good in it.

objects.title: accept it
objects.text: You did not immediately accept the power, but you refused to let it define you either. You chose when to use it, when to stop, what lines you would not cross. You may not understand the power yet. You may not even like it. But it belongs to you now and you will not let it turn you into somebody else.

rows.title: The First instinct
rows.titleText:
"The first few days after awakening are always revealing."

A person can say whatever they like about who they are, But give them power and none of the responsibility and watch their true colors unfold.

What is your response to this new change?

rows.title: The Role
rows.titleText:
"Well then... The curtain has risen, the auditions are over, and all those little choices you made along the way have finally caught up with you.

Did you really think they were meaningless? None of it was random. Long before your awakening, your Role had already begun nudging your life in subtle ways"

Your Role is the single greatest force that will shape the rest of your life. It decides the kind of powers that answer your call, the instincts that come naturally to you, and the place you are most likely to carve for yourself in this strange little performance we call the world.

objects.title: Role: The Phantom
objects.text:
Most people spend their lives trying to be noticed. You became someone the world struggled to notice at all.

Whether by circumstance or by choice, you became comfortable slipping through the cracks. You learned when to speak, when to disappear, and when letting people underestimate you was far more valuable than demanding their attention. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Phantom.

As a Phantom, you embody mystery itself. You are difficult to define, difficult to predict and, more often than not, difficult to catch. You uncover truths that were never meant to be found, slip into places thought impossible to reach and vanish long before anyone realizes you were ever there. There is something deeply unsettling about a Phantom. They appear and leave without warning, Know more than they should. People may spend years convincing themselves monsters are not real, but a single encounter with a Phantom changes that belief.

objects.title: Role: The Serpent
objects.text:
Power is a wonderfully blunt instrument.. People, on the other hand, are far more useful.

Long before your Role awakened, you understood that convincing someone was often easier than fighting them. Whatever the reason, you learned to read people, understand what they wanted, and gently steer them toward the outcome you preferred. A push here. A lie there. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Serpent.

They are planners, manipulators and opportunists, always thinking several steps ahead. That does not make a Serpent dishonest by nature. Many become remarkable leaders, negotiators or strategists. Others become manipulators capable of burning down cities without ever lifting a finger themselves. Those who underestimate a Serpent usually make the same mistake. They spend too much time watching the fangs...

They never notice the coils tightening around them.

objects.title: Role: The Beast
objects.text: People spend an awful lot of time pretending they're above their animal nature, They couldn't be more wrong.. Before your Role awakened, you lived through your instincts. You trusted your gut, wore your emotions openly and rarely felt the need to pretend otherwise. Your anger was fierce, your joy infectious and your sorrow was deep. You experienced life at its fullest, for better or for worse. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Beast. A Beast embodies raw conviction. They are relentless, fearless and terrifyingly honest with themselves. They rarely waste time overthinking, because they do not need to. When they choose a direction, they commit with everything they have, throwing their entire body and soul into whatever stands before them. Obstacles are not puzzles to solve, they are to be teared through until nothing remains between them and their goal. There is no deception in a Beast, no hidden agenda or second face. What you see is exactly what stands before you.

objects.title: Role: The Mastermind
objects.text:
Most people see the world as it is. You couldn't help wondering why it had to stay that way.

Long before your Role awakened, you learned to trust your mind above everything else. You questioned what others accepted, noticed details they dismissed and found satisfaction in learning. You were rarely content with the obvious answer. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Mastermind.

A Mastermind embodies intellect in its purest form. They are inventors, tacticians, researchers and innovators, driven by an endless curiosity to understand more, discover more and improve upon what already exists. Knowledge is only the beginning. The true strength of a Mastermind lies in their ability to learn, adapt and evolve. Every mistake becomes another lesson for them. When a carefully crafted plan falls apart, they simply build another. The longer someone stands against them, the more they unknowingly help with defeating them.

objects.title: Role: The Jester
objects.text:
Life becomes awfully boring when everyone behaves exactly as expected. Fortunately, You never had that problem. Whether it was curiosity, boredom or simply finding the ordinary unbearable, you developed a habit of doing the unexpected. Life became much more interesting once you stopped worrying about how it was supposed to be lived. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Jester.

A Jester thrives on unpredictability. They refuse to let life become stale, constantly turning situations on their head simply because they can. Their presence alone has a habit of throwing careful plans into disarray, forcing everyone around them to abandon certainty and adapt on the fly. Their actions often appear random to outsiders, but there is usually a strange sort of logic behind the madness that only they can understand. You cannot outplay someone who was never playing your game to begin with.

objects.title: Role: The Maverick
objects.text:
Some people are content walking the road laid out before them. You always looked for the road not taken.

Whether it was curiosity, restlessness or simply refusing to accept that something was impossible, you developed a habit of doing things your own way. Rules and expectations always felt strangely suffocating. You chased what interested you and wandered wherever your curiosity led to. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Maverick. A Maverick embodies freedom in its purest form. They are explorers, adventurers and daredevils who refuse to be boxed into a single way of thinking. If there is a shortcut, they will find it. If there is a loophole, they will exploit it. Mavericks are explorers at heart, though exploration means far more than travelling the world. They explore ideas, possibilities and every solution everyone else was too stubborn to consider. Trying to pin down a maverick like locking the wind inside a cage, They simply cannot be caged.

objects.title: Role: The Guardian
objects.text: Someone has to stand between innocent people and the things that would harm them. You simply decided that someone might as well be you. Long before your Role awakened, you found it difficult to ignore suffering, unfairness or people who abused their strength. You were never the sort to look away and hope someone else would step in. Whether it meant taking the blame, risking yourself or standing against someone stronger. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Guardian. A Guardian embodies unwavering resolve. They are protectors, defenders and champions who stand firm when others cannot. They are not driven by glory, nor by the thrill of battle. They fight because someone has to. They possess an unwavering determination that refuses to yield in the face of overwhelming odds, becoming the wall others rally behind when everything else begins to fall apart. A Guardian refuses to watch others suffer when they have the strength to stop it.

objects.title: Role: The Paragon
objects.text:
Hope has always been a curious thing. It spreads far more easily than people give it credit for.

Long before your Role awakened, you tried to leave the world a little better than you found it. You reached out to people who were struggling, offered help without expecting anything in return and never underestimated how much a single person could change another's life. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Paragon.

A Paragon embodies hope, compassion and unwavering ideals. They believe people can become better than they are today and devote themselves this ideal. They inspire not through speeches or empty promises, but through the way they live their lives. Their ideals are not empty promises. They live by them, even when it would be easier not to. That unwavering sincerity leaves a lasting impression on everyone around them, even those who oppose them often find themselves respecting them, for there is no deceit in their kindness and no lies in their words.

objects.title: Role: The Brute
objects.text:
People spend far too much time worrying about the right way to do something. In the end, what matters is whether it gets done. Long before your Role awakened, you confronted life head-on. Once you committed yourself, there was very little anyone could do to change your course. You would rather break through an obstacle than waste your time walking around it. You never saw much value in over complicating things than they had to be. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Brute.

A Brute embodies resolve, force and unwavering conviction. They are frighteningly direct, refusing to waste energy on deception or elaborate schemes when they can settle matters with their own hands. Their strength is not merely physical. It is the sheer certainty behind every action they take. If a path exists, they take it. If one does not, they make one. Once they've made up their mind, the world can either move... or be moved.

objects.title: Role: The Siren
objects.text:
The human mind is surprisingly easy to influence once you understand what it wants to believe.

Long before your Role awakened, you understood people far better than they understood themselves. You noticed the fears they buried, the desires they refused to acknowledge and the cracks they worked so hard to hide. Reading people became second nature, and before long, so did guiding people toward the conclusions you wanted them to reach. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Siren.

A Siren embodies influence and psychological warfare. They navigate the human mind with unsettling ease, effortlessly peeling back the masks others spend their lives constructing and force your will onto them.

You cannot defend yourself against manipulation you never realize is happening. The strongest chains are the ones people willingly wrapped around themselves.

objects.title: Role: The Usurper
objects.text:
Fairness is a wonderful idea. It has also been the reason many capable people ended up losing. Long before your Role awakened, you learned that the world did not reward good intentions nearly as often as it rewarded results. Rules, loyalties and expectations were only as valuable as the results they produced, and the moment they stopped being useful, you saw little reason to cling to them. That is why the Narrative cast you as the Usurper.

A Usurper embodies opportunism, pragmatism and ruthless adaptability. They have little interest in fair fights or honorable victories. They possess an uncanny instinct for recognizing opportunity wherever it appears, turning people and circumstances into stepping stones. Chameleons by nature, they slip between alliances, identities and ideals whenever doing so serves them best. What makes an Usurper truly dangerous is their complete willingness to cheat if it secures victory. The world has never belonged to the worthy. Only to those willing to take it.

objects.title: Role: The Undying
objects.text:
Long before your Role awakened, you had an infuriating habit of coming back. Life threw everything it could at you. Failure, loss, hardship and setbacks that should have been enough to make anyone walk away. Yet every time the dust settled, there you were again. You learned to work with what you had, adapting to situations that should have overwhelmed you and finding opportunities where others saw only dead ends. You became frighteningly difficult to keep down. That is why the Narrative cast you as the Undying.

The Undying embodies perseverance and adaptability. They are defined by their refusal to die, returning again and again from situations that should've killed them. They possess an extraordinary ability to endure and recover from defeat. They are opportunists in the truest sense of the word, constantly adapting to whatever the world throws at them. Some stories simply refuse to end, no matter how many times the final page is turned.

objects.title: Role: The Dragon
objects.text: There comes a point where proving yourself to others simply stops being worth the effort. Long before your Role awakened, you were unapologetically yourself. You knew your worth, took pride in your abilities and never felt the need to diminish yourself to make others comfortable. You were who you were, with or without anyone else's approval. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Dragon. A Dragon embodies supremacy, pride and absolute self-assurance. They stand at the very peak of the Narrative, blessed with power so absolute that few Roles can genuinely challenge them. A Dragon rarely fights seriously, because there is little satisfaction in overcoming opponents they never considered equals to begin with. That detachment often makes them appear distant, indifferent or even lazy. They are content to let the world move without them, pursuing only the things that genuinely capture their interest and refuse to be dragged into the ambitions of lesser people.

objects.title: Role: The Calamity
objects.text:
Long before your Role awakened, you had an unfortunate habit of pushing everything just a little too far. Whether through stubbornness, arrogance or simple disregard for consequences, you had a tendency to escalate things because of your refusal to take half-measures. If something needed to change, you believed it should change completely. Others often blamed you for making everything worse. You simply refused to pretend that broken things could be held together forever. That is why the Narrative cast you as a Calamity.

A Calamity embodies upheaval, destruction and irreversible change. They are among the few Roles capable of rivaling a Dragon. A Calamity is a force that accelerates the inevitable. They expose weaknesses others desperately try to ignore, forcing conflicts into the open and bringing long-simmering tensions to their breaking point. The only certainty surrounding a Calamity is that certainty itself won't survive for long.

objects.title: Role: The order
objects.text:
People spend their lives searching for who they should become. But the answer had been there all along.

Long before your Role, you found comfort in certainty. You disliked vague answers and questions that seemed to have no end. Where others saw shades of grey, you searched for black & white. You believed everything has its purpose and every problem has a correct answer. That is why the Narrative cast you as The Order.

The Order embodies purpose, authority and absolute conviction. They believe the world functions best when everything stands where it belongs, fulfilling the role it was always meant to play. They establish structure wherever they go, bringing stability to disorder and giving shape to the chaos. They naturally reject ambiguity, preferring clear principles over convenient exceptions and objective truth over comforting lies. A life spent chasing every possibility usually ends without belonging to any of them.

objects.title: Role: The Aberration
objects.text:
The world is built upon patterns. You had a wonderful habit of becoming the exception.

Long before your Role awakened, you never fit comfortably into the expectations placed upon you. People struggled to understand your choices, your way of thinking and your nature. You refused to be neatly defined by labels, expectations or even your own past. That is why the Narrative cast you as an The Aberration. An Aberration embodies change, unpredictability and endless possibility. Unlike every other Role, they are not bound by a clear identity or purpose. There is no single path they are meant to follow, no philosophy they are expected to uphold and no mold they are destined to fit into. They exist to challenge certainty itself. Yet an Aberration can never afford to become complacent. The moment they settle into routine or allow themselves to be predictable, they cease to embody what makes them extraordinary. They are the wildcards of the Narrative itself.

objects.title: Gift: Iron Body
objects.text:
Your body has been rebuilt from the inside out, every muscle fiber, tendon, ligament and even your bones strengthened far beyond what human physiology should ever be capable of.

The most immediate benefit is your sheer physical strength. Lifting fifty tons becomes falls well within your capabilities, ability to tear apart steel structures and throwing vehicles like projectiles are possible with ease.

That strength is matched by equally supernatural durability. Your skin, muscles and skeleton absorb impacts with astonishing efficiency, dispersing forces that would instantly cripple an ordinary person. Bullets flatten against your skin, shotgun blasts leave little more than bruises and falls from towering buildings become little more than an inconvenience.

Your cardiovascular system delivers oxygen with incredible efficiency, your lungs recover from exertion in moments and your stamina allows you to sprint at nearly 40 kmph for close to an hour before true fatigue sets in.

Diseases struggle to gain a foothold, your immune system becomes is more resilient and your body naturally maintains peak physical condition regardless of minor fluctuations in lifestyle. Despite possessing such overwhelming strength, your body remains remarkably precise. You can still shake hold glass or type on a keyboard without any accidents.

objects.title: Gift: Overpressure
objects.text:
Your palms possess the extraordinary ability to seize the air itself. By creating a localized vacuum, you violently draw the surrounding atmosphere inward before compressing it into an impossibly dense pocket. The pressure rises in an instant until the air collapses into a focused detonation. The resulting blasts possess overwhelming power, powerful enough to hurl vehicles through the air, pulverize reinforced concrete and eradicate entire streets at maximum output.

Naturally, your own body has evolved to withstand such violence. Your palms and forearms are completely immune to the extreme temperatures generated, granting you an exceptional resistance to heat. The recoil that would tear another person's arms from their shoulders becomes a source of movement instead. By directing successive blasts beneath your feet or behind your back, you can rocket across the battlefield, change direction midair or even sustain controlled flight for short periods. Explosions can be fired in in a compressed area at short range to act as shields, intercepting incoming attacks before they ever reach you.

The true beauty of this power lies in its versatility. Every explosion can be adjusted in size, intensity and direction, allowing anything from precise concussive bursts to devastating blasts capable of leveling entire streets.

objects.title: Gift: Osteokinesis
objects.text:
Your skeleton has become a living organ of perpetual growth, capable of restructuring itself in ways no natural biology should allow. Every bone in your body exists in a state of accelerated cellular activity, constantly producing an impossibly durable mineral-organic composite that can be shaped and directed entirely by your will.

You may trigger localized growth anywhere within your skeleton. Entire lengths of bone can erupt from your arms, shoulders, spine or fingertips in a completely painless process, emerging in whatever shape you want. Razor-sharp blades, crushing hammers, reinforced gauntlets, Shields, Spears and much more, they possess tremendous structural integrity and can withstand impacts that would shatter conventional steel.

Your control does not end once the bone leaves your body. Every piece remains weakly connected through a supernatural telekinetic field for some time, allowing you to suspend floating bone fragments around yourself as defensive barriers or manipulate entire masses after they have formed, A single spike can be fired with enough force to punch clean through reinforced steel if you focus on it.

Prolonged growth of skeleton will exhaust your own skeleton, forcing the ability to go on cooldown for 5 minutes till it recovers.

objects.title: Gift: Steamheart
objects.text:
Your heart has been transformed into an engine unlike anything found in nature. The moment you will it, the entire organ enters a different operating state. Chambers hidden within the heart begin contracting at incredible speeds, forcing your blood through microscopic vessels. As the pressure rises, so does heat, superheating the compressed blood to temperatures far beyond what living tissue should ever survive.

Temporary pores can open anywhere across your skin, acting as a controlled exhaust for the pressure building within you. The instant the compressed blood reaches open air, it violently flashes into superheated steam, releasing enormous amounts of force without harming you in the slightest. The blood itself is immediately restored through your ability, allowing the process to continue indefinitely without danger.

The most immediate use of this power is overwhelming physical acceleration. By venting steam behind your fists, elbows, knees or feet at the exact moment of impact, every strike receives the explosive momentum of an industrial piston. Broad vents across your back or feet generate powerful bursts of propulsion, allowing you to dash with startling speed, leap impossible distances or sustain brief periods of controlled aerial movement by constantly adjusting the direction of your exhaust.

objects.title: Gift: Titanic
objects.text:
Your body houses an extraordinary biological catalyst capable of converting vast quantities of surrounding water into living tissue at impossible speeds. The instant you activate your ability, moisture from the environment is violently drawn toward you before being broken apart at the molecular level and reconstructed into Muscle, bone, tendons and armor-like flesh that begins growing around you in seconds, forming an enormous humanoid body with you inside acting as its core.

The entire transformation is driven by the amount of available moisture in your surroundings, meaning a dry battlefield produces a smaller Titan.

Under ordinary conditions your Titan comfortably reaches heights of around 25 meters, wielding immense physical strength approaching three quarters of what Iron Body grants. Rivers, lakes, heavy rainfall and other abundant sources dramatically accelerate tissue production, allowing your Titan to continue growing until it reaches an upper limit of roughly sixty meters, At which point It is capable of toppling skyscrapers with ease.

Raw durability is the Titan's greatest weakness. Although small arms fire barely scratches its dense biological armor, sustained heavy weaponry, explosives and attacks from powerful superhumans will gradually tear away its body, forcing you to reform another one.

objects.title: Gift: Calculus
objects.text:
Reality is far more organized than most people realize. Every object is nothing more than countless smaller parts arranged in a very specific way. Your ability allows you to temporarily impose the mathematical concepts of differentiation and integration upon the physical world itself.

By bringing your palms within roughly 10 meters of a target, you may initiate Differentiation, causing invisible spatial fractures to propagate throughout the object. Rather than crudely slicing through matter, the ability intelligently separates structures along their natural boundaries. A brick wall effortlessly falls into individual bricks, a vehicle disassembles into thousands of perfectly separated components and even intricate machinery comes apart bolt by bolt without damaging a single piece.

Within a 10 second window, you may invoke Integration, reconstructing every differentiated component in whatever arrangement you desire, provided the available material can physically support the result. A demolished bridge may become an enormous staircase. A shattered car can be rebuilt into an armored barricade. The ability remains astonishingly precise. Individual sections of a target can be differentiated while the remainder is left untouched. The maximum value you can affect is 1200 m³, enough to cover an airplane.

objects.title: Gift: Command Chain
objects.text:
At your command, 30 supernatural chains total erupt from specialized gateways located within your palms and mouth. Once fired, every chain remains connected to your nervous system, granting you precise control over them, obeying your will as naturally as your own limbs, twisting, coiling and changing direction through the air. A chain may lash outward as a whip, quietly snake across the ground or weave through narrow openings before whipping as you will it.

Each chain's hooked tip embeds itself into nearly any surface, allowing you to swing across cities, instantly change direction in midair and due to supernatural origin lets you drag objects has heavy as 200Kg with ease or act as shield to protect from most conventional firearms.

Among the dozens of ordinary chains exists a special chain known only as the King's Chain marked by a snake like end. Should the it pierce the base of a target's neck, It establishes a direct connection with their nervous system. From that moment onward, the victim's body becomes subject to your commands for the next 45 minutes. They remain fully conscious throughout the entire process, able to think but cannot control their body from obeying your commands. The connection remains active until you willingly release it or 45 minutes have passed or the chain is melted off.

objects.title: Gift: Shadow Legion
objects.text:
Your shadow is no longer merely the absence of light. It has become an extension of yourself, responding to your thoughts as naturally as any other limb. With concentration, it can spread across nearby surfaces, flowing unnaturally over walls, ceilings and uneven terrain.

The simplest application is the creation of shadow limbs. Hands, arms and tendrils may emerge from shadow within a 50m, allowing you to manipulate distant objects, restrain opponents or perform delicate tasks far beyond your normal reach. Your maximum limit is 100 limbs and even that puts great strain on you mentally.

The true strength of the ability lies within the Legion itself.

By sacrificing 4 limbs, You may give birth to autonomous shadow bodies that rise from darkness and gradually take an identical look to you. Every clone shares a single consciousness with you. They do not require verbal communication, cannot misunderstand instructions and instinctively adapt to changing situations exactly as you would. While individually no stronger than your normal body, the Legion excels through coordination impossible for ordinary people to achieve. Their greatest weakness, however, is light. Bright illumination gradually erodes their bodies, while direct sunlight rapidly tears them apart altogether within seconds.

objects.title: Gift: Godspeed
objects.text:
Your nervous system has been transformed into a biological superconductor, allowing electrical impulses to travel through your body with virtually no resistance. Every signal exchanged between your brain and muscles is amplified to impossible levels, dramatically increasing the speed at which your body can think, react and move.

The most immediate effect is speed bordering on the inhuman. Even for extended periods, you can comfortably maintain speeds approaching 300 kilometers per hour while your perception and reflexes accelerate enough to barely process movement at those velocities. When absolute performance is required, your nervous system may enter a temporary Overdrive state. During these brief bursts, your acceleration can momentarily reach speeds comparable to a bullet train.

The immense electrical potential generated by your nervous system naturally overflows beyond your skin, allowing you to project it into the surrounding environment for variety of offensive and defensive uses. Although your nervous system conducts electricity with ease, the rest of your body must still endure the immense heat generated by operating at such extremes. Long periods of movement gradually raises your internal temperature, making prolonged use increasingly exhausting.

objects.title: Gift: Darwin
objects.text:
At will, your body may enter a state of rapid biological reconstruction by encasing itself within a living cocoon. Over the next 3 seconds, countless specialized cells begin dismantling and rebuilding your body at extraordinary speed. During this process you are almost completely immobile and vulnerable. Should the cocoon be destroyed before time is up, the adaptation fails, forcing the ability into a 2 minute cooldown.

If the metamorphosis completes successfully, the cocoon ruptures and you emerge with a body specifically evolved to survive the greatest threat you recently encountered. The transformation is governed entirely by your body's own survival instincts. It analyzes the most significant injuries sustained shortly before activation together with the surrounding environment, identifying whichever poses the greatest danger before constructing a biological solution. Evolution is always practical, ensuring your new biology gives you the means to fight back as well as survive.

Only one adaptation can exist at any given time, But said adaption rewrites your body to grant various physiological advantages and traits to be extremely useful for that scenario. Such dramatic biological reconstruction demands roughly 750 Calories every time you invoke Darwin to rewrite your body and cannot be some all-encompassing adaption.

objects.title: Gift: Golconda
objects.text:
Your body possesses the ability to induce an extraordinary form of crystallization, causing diamond-like mineral structures to grow at explosive speeds from your own body as well as from any solid surface physically connected to your hands within range of 50 meters.

The simplest application is defense. Gaint walls, towering pillars can lift allies to safety and domes may burst violently from the earth, intercepting attacks before they ever reach you, Able to withstand staggering amounts of punishment, shrugging off explosions and even heavy military weaponry.

The same crystallization can be directed offensively as projectiles but to achieve the tremendous speeds required for projectiles, Its durability gets compromised in favour of lighter, sharper growth. While still easily capable of piercing flesh, wood and concrete, these lighter crystals are more likely to fracture against hardened steel.

Your own body serves as an equally potent point of growth. Crystalline armor may rapidly spread across your skin, flowing over your body in articulated plates that remain surprisingly flexible despite their immense durability, allowing you to walk unharmed through collapsing structures and explosions while retaining your full range of movement. This armor can be extended to upto 6 other people besides you.

objects.title: Gift: Pantheon
objects.text:
10 radiant rings perpetually orbit your body, impossible constructs forged from an unknown divine substance that exists beyond conventional matter. They obey your thoughts alone, allowing you to control each ring independently within roughly 100 meters. Their size may be freely adjusted, expanding to nearly 2 times their normal diameter of 15cm at will. Though entirely weightless to you, they possess immense inertia against the world.

All rings are able to shift into 2 distinct states all at once:

  • Judgment leaves the center of the ring open, greatly reducing resistance and allowing speeds upto 75 m/s. In this form the rings become devastating kinetic weapons, smashing through concrete, ricocheting around the battlefield. They can also carry your own body if you grabbed them while flying for travel or levitation.

  • Sanctuary fills the hollow center with a radiant disc of solid light, transforming the ring into a floating shield of extraordinary durability. While being slower only reaching speeds of 12 m/s, each ring weighs nearly 450Kg tons, allowing it to block projectile, halt charging vehicles, shield allies, pin opponents beneath its weight or simply become an immovable wall wherever you need one.

objects.title: Gift: Zeeman effect
objects.text:
Your body constantly generates an anomalous electromagnetic field capable of interacting directly with visible light. While far too weak to affect solid matter, it can alter the path photons travel through the surrounding space. The most basic use is optical cloaking. By smoothly curving incoming light around your body before allowing it to continue along its original path, you become nearly invisible to the naked eye.

The same field may instead gather surrounding light and compress it into a dense shell surrounding your body. This condensed layer forms a decent barrier capable of enduring bullets and few shotgun rounds and naturally expands to protect anyone in direct physical contact with you.

Light may also be concentrated into an extremely small focal point before being released. The result is a short-lived beam carrying enormous thermal energy capable of melting steel or slicng through reinforced concrete.

Because every technique relies upon the same electromagnetic field, only one major application may be maintained at any given time. Every application depends upon available light. Bright environments allow the field to replenish itself almost continuously, whereas darkness, heavy fog or smoke dramatically reduce both the strength and efficiency of every technique except optical cloaking which merely bends the light around you.

objects.title: Gift: Authority
objects.text:
Your right palm bears the Seal of Authority, an anomalous mark capable of imposing absolute Directives upon the world itself. Anything without a will is considered naturally beneath your authority, allowing you to freely brand objects with dormant commands, each consisting of a specific action paired with a triggering condition. It remains completely inactive until either its condition is fulfilled or you choose to activate it yourself.

A locked door may unlock the moment footsteps approach. A chandelier may detach precisely as someone passes beneath it. A security camera may rotate away at exactly midnight. The Directive never violates reality. It simply compels an object to perform an action it was already physically capable of carrying out with an added help of animation.

Only 10 Directives may exist at any one time, forcing careful planning over reckless use. People are fundamentally different. One cannot simply place another person beneath Authority by force. They must first accept your Authority, however unknowingly. A handshake. A gift accepted from your hand. Signing an agreement. Taking an offered object. Receiving your help. In that brief moment of voluntary acceptance, reality briefly recognizes your authority over them and gives a chance to place the seal. Unlike objects, these Directives cannot be activated at your whim.

Your fingers and feet develop a supernatural electromagnetic interaction with surfaces, allowing you to adhere to walls, ceilings and other structures without needing conventional grips. You can crawl across vertical surfaces with ease or hang upside down indefinitely.

By focusing the electromagnetic interference into violent microscopic vibrations, anything you touch can be forced into an accelerated state of entropy, effectively pushing the target further along the natural process of deterioration that would normally take years. objects.text:

Rather than remembering every simulation individually, each completed loop devours itself, carrying only the lessons, discoveries and corrections into the next cycle. This allows the simulations to rapidly refine themselves toward the probable future. Every loop is built upon your own intelligence, observations and experience, with the ability subtly filling in only the data necessary for the next loop to improve upon the last.

You instinctively know where attacks are likely to come from, which choices are most likely to succeed and how conversations are likely to unfold. objects.title: Gift: Requiem
objects.text:
Your vocal cords have undergone a complete supernatural transformation, allowing them to generate vibrations far beyond the limits of ordinary biology. Specialized tissues surrounding your larynx act as living resonance chambers, capable of producing frequencies ranging from deep infrasonic pulses to ultrasonic vibrations completely beyond human hearing.

At full power, your voice produces devastating sonic shockwaves capable of shattering concrete, rupturing steel supports and hurling opponents backwards through sheer force. The vibrations can be focused into narrow blasts for precision or released as broad waves that batter everything in front of you. With careful control, those same shockwaves can also be directed beneath your feet, providing bursts of propulsion that dramatically increase your mobility or soften otherwise dangerous falls.

The most unsettling application requires almost no sound at all. By compressing your voice into an extremely narrow band of near-inaudible frequencies and delivering it directly into another person's ear, you generate a resonance that interacts only with living neural tissue. The synchronized electrical activity responsible for consolidating recent memories falls out of phase with itself, leaving the victim unable to recall roughly the last ten minutes. This can be used for echolocation too.

objects.title: Gift: Kaleidoscope
objects.text:
By invoking Kaleidoscope, the space surrounding you fractures into a brilliant mosaic of shifting colors, fractured reflections and overlapping images. For only an instant, reality loses its certainty as countless reflected versions of the world briefly exist alongside the original. During this state, any reflective surface within roughly twenty meters becomes a valid extension of physical space, allowing you to move through reflections as though they were ordinary doorways.

Almost anything capable of reflecting an image can serve as a gateway. Mirrors, windows, polished metal, still water, phone screens, television displays, camera lenses, glossy floors and even framed photographs may all become temporary entrances, traversing entire buildings or crossing crowded streets without ever being physically present. Because the distortion places considerable strain on the underlying space, Kaleidoscope requires roughly five seconds before it can be invoked again to leave or jump to another reflective surface nearby.

The distortion itself also serves as an exceptional defensive tool. As reality splinters around you, It becomes capable of intercepting incoming attacks. Bullets, blades and even powerful explosions must first shatter these fractured layers before ever reaching you.

objects.title: Gift: Zoan
objects.text:
This gift permanently binds your body to the essence of a single animal, allowing your biology to flow freely between human and beast without limit. You possess complete control over every aspect of the transformation. Individual limbs may be altered independently or just eyes to inherit the traits or jaws to develop crushing bite force while the remainder of your body stays human. Transformations are instantaneous in nature.

You may also abandon your human form entirely, transforming into your chosen animal. Despite retaining its natural appearance, every aspect of the creature is dramatically enhanced. It becomes roughly twice the size, strength and endurance of an ordinary specimen while remaining perfectly healthy and under your complete control.

Your greatest form, however, is the Hybrid. Standing nearly 2.5 metres tall, this towering fusion combines the intelligence of a human with the raw physiology of your beast. Strength rises high enough to tear apart vehicles with ease and fast enough to surpass peak human speed. The defining traits of your animal become magnified far beyond anything found in nature. A bear's strength becomes monstrous or a cheetah's speed is fast than supercars, But keeping this form active puts massive strain on you and cannot be sustained beyond 6 minutes of active use before needing rest.

objects.title: Gift: Garden of Eden
objects.text:
This gift grants absolute authority over living plant life within roughly 80 metres of your position. Every root, vine, branch and blade of grass becomes an extension of your own will, capable of growing, moving and reshaping itself with impossible speed at your command.

Unlike ordinary plants, yours are born through explosive supernatural growth. At a thought, roots erupt through concrete, vines burst from walls, tree trunks explode upward from shattered roads and entire forests can consume open ground within seconds. The plants themselves possess extraordinary strength. Trees erupt from roads with enough force to overturn vehicles, Vines thicker than steel cables lash through the air with tremendous force, wrapping around vehicles before crushing them flat. Leaves may harden into razor-sharp blades before launching in dense storms capable of slicing through flesh.

Carnivorous flowers large enough to engulf vehicles may bloom beneath unsuspecting enemies, while tangled root systems drag opponents underground or pin them helplessly against walls. Just as easily as you command growth, you may instantly reverse the process, causing every construct to rapidly wither and collapse into dust before dissolving entirely. Entire forests of vegetation collapse into dust within moments.

objects.title: Gift: Beelzebub
objects.text:
This gift transforms your body into the source of an impossible pheromone unlike anything found in nature. Hidden along your neck are several specialized gland-like vents that continuously release an invisible chemical signal. The pheromone spreads gradually, requiring roughly fifteen minutes to fully saturate an area with a radius of around 150 metres. Unlike ordinary pheromones, however, It transcends species, influencing ants, termites, bees, wasps, cockroaches, beetles, spiders, centipedes within your range.

Any suitable creature exposed to it instinctively abandons its previous priorities and begins making its way toward you, recognizing you as their queen. Once gathered, you may alter the composition of the pheromone itself, issuing commands through them. The swarm responds with extraordinary precision, They may attack as a giant mass, chew through wiring, infiltrate buildings, retrieve small objects, construct bridges and cushions from their own bodies, or completely envelop you to carry you across terrain. Venoms, parasites, bacteria and filth carried by your swarm are rendered completely incapable of harming you.

You neither see nor hear through the swarm, trusting them entirely to complete whatever task you assign. They cannot improvise beyond the intent you provide, and cannot travel beyond 70m from you once exposed.

objects.title: Gift: Cataclysm
objects.text:
Everything in the world possesses a natural frequency. Buildings, mountains, bridges, even the air itself all carry invisible vibrations that normally pass unnoticed. Your body has become capable of generating oscillations powerful enough to overwhelm those natural frequencies.

The simplest expression of this gift is to channel vibrations through your own body to execute devastating hits that bypasses much of a target's surface durability, rattling them from the inside. By maintaining contact, you may continuously vibrate an object or opponent, rapidly weakening them. The true expression of the gift comes when those vibrations are released into the air itself. By overdriving your body's resonance and releasing it into open air, you generate an immense pressure rupture.

The atmosphere itself briefly becomes the medium for your vibrations, producing an expanding shockwave capable of collapsing massive structures. At its greatest output, repeated ruptures could bring down giant suspension bridges, level city blocks or trigger landslides across entire mountainsides with relative ease. Despite its terrifying power, resonance is difficult to contain once released and leaves a residual disturbance, Attempting another major rupture before the previous vibrations have settled will cause massive backfire onto your vessel.
