objects.title: Gift: Heaven Fall
objects.text:
The heavens have always been associated with forces beyond human control. Meteors are pieces of that distant violence made visible, celestial bodies crossing impossible distances before arriving as devastating impacts upon this planet. Your ability allows you to call upon that phenomenon directly from heavens above for your own use.

The simplest expression is the Meteor Fall itself. You can call down a roughly one-metre meteor above a chosen point within range of 120 meters and send it crashing downward at around 60 km/h. Even at this relatively modest speed, the mass is enough to produce a brutal impact, capable of crushing down a car. You can freely increase its speed, enlarge its size or summon several simultaneously. You can push the phenomenon toward absurd extremes, eventually producing a single 80-metre meteor or calling down a barrage of up to 100 smaller bodies to bombard entire areas.

You can summon comets, allowing yourself or others to ride upon them for rapid movement. A comet can carry you through the air at tremendous speed for several dozen metres before its supernatural structure burns itself apart. The ability however cannot be freely used, too many meteor impacts in an area will rapidly overheat the surrounding atmosphere and will rapidly start exhausting your mental stamina beyond that.

objects.title: Gift: Earthshaker
objects.text:
The ground is usually treated as something passive by most people. A surface to stand on, something buildings are anchored into and roads are laid across. To you, it is an extension of your body, responding to the smallest movement of your feet as though it were another limb.

Within a radius of 60 metres, you can command up to 50 tonnes of earth simultaneously, moving that mass however you desire through nothing more than footwork. A stomp can make the ground erupt. A sliding step can drag an entire section of earth sideways. A sharp kick can send a slab of stone tearing upward. You can raise walls and barricades, thrust pillars from the ground to elevate yourself, create ramps and platforms, or open sudden sinkholes beneath targets. You can even suspend controlled earth above the ground, allowing you to create floating platforms or airborne projectiles.

Your connection with the ground also gives you seismic perception. Vibrations traveling through the terrain within your range are detected through your feet, allowing you to sense movement, vibrations and disturbances beneath and above the surface. You may not see someone hiding behind a wall, but if they move, drop something or shift their weight, the earth can tell you where they are through this sense, granting you full awareness of anything anchored to earth.

objects.title: Gift: Frame drop
objects.text:
Lag is the delay between an action happening and the world successfully displaying it. Your ability forces that logic of digital lag into physical reality. When activated, your heart begins beating at an absurd rate, pumping blood through your body so violently that the electromagnetic and biological activity surrounding you begins interfering with the continuity of local reality. Within roughly 60 metres, the world starts losing frames.

You can deliberately exploit this phenomenon by forcing the world to skip frames. Once every twelve seconds, you may remove roughly one second from the collective awareness of everyone within your range. To everyone caught within the effect, roughly the next second simply disappears. They do not experience themselves moving through it. One instant they are beginning an action, and the next they have already done it.

Then comes the more dangerous application: Fracture.

You can split your existence into several temporary versions of yourself, each representing a different continuation of the same moment. Each one can move independently and perform actions, allowing you to attack from several directions, search multiple locations or overwhelm an opponent. They can remain manifested for a maximum of 30 secs before the fracture collapses into a chosen version and enters 10 second cooldown.

objects.title: Gift: Dragon
objects.text:
Dragons are the embodiment of overwhelming force in countless legends, creatures so enormous and furious that nature itself bows for them. This ability can only awaken when genuine rage exists within you. It does not matter what caused it. Once you willingly surrender to that emotion, your body erupts into an enormous cloud of steam.

A 500-metre-long Eastern dragon emerges from the vapor, its serpentine body twisting through the sky. Its body possesses extraordinary durability, capable of enduring impacts that would destroy ordinary structures and physically overwhelm enormous areas simply through movement. Despite its size, the dragon remains surprisingly agile and capable of sustained flight at roughly 90 km/h, allowing it to cross cities and pursue targets from above.

But the dragon's true weapon is rage itself. The anger sustaining your transformation can be condensed inside your mouth into an intensely concentrated stream of supernatural plasma. When released, the beam carves through entire sections of a city. The stronger the emotion you pour into the attack, the more powerful the beam becomes, but every second of sustained fire also burns away the anger keeping the transformation alive. Once the transformation ends, whether voluntarily or because your rage has been exhausted, Dragon enters a 10-minute cooldown.

objects.title: Gift: Möbius Strip
objects.text:
A Möbius strip is a strange mathematical object with only one continuous surface and one edge. Walk along it long enough and you eventually return to where you began, despite never turning around. Your ability forces this strange topology upon ordinary space, Within roughly 60 metres, you can manipulate nearby space according to this principle.

The most immediate expression is your Möbius Guard. By crossing your fingers on both your hands to emulate the strip, you may create a warped region around your body. Any physical object moving toward you at 8 m/s or higher has its momentum redirected along a distorted path that eventually returns it toward where it came from, effectively stopping it from approaching you beyond 5cm from your body. The distortion only interacts with physical mass moving above roughly 8 m/s.

The more aggressive applications involve manipulating the space between things. You can collapse the empty distance between objects within your range. A distant object can therefore be pulled directly into your hands or you can collapse the distance and effectively teleport around. The reverse application while weaker is considerably more violent, You can expand the available space behind an object and you, forcing anything smaller than a football to be ejected away from you at breakneck speeds of 180 km/h.

objects.title: Gift: Tempest
objects.text:
Wind is the movement of air caused by differences in pressure, temperature and density. Most of the time, those forces produce nothing more dramatic than a breeze. But when enough air begins moving in the same direction, the energy involved becomes enormous. A storm is simply the atmosphere organizing that energy into something violent.

Your ability allows you to interfere directly with those atmospheric movements. Within your range of 100m, you can increase, redirect and organize the motion of air, creating powerful gusts capable of knocking people away, redirecting projectiles, slowing movement or launching objects through the air. By concentrating your control around yourself, you may increase air resistance to act as protection or reduce it boost your movement speed or create bursts of wind that can propel you.

By forcing opposing air currents to curve around one another, you can create a vortex and continuously feed it with additional energy. Given enough time and concentration, these vortices can become full-scale tornadoes capable of ripping apart entire cities down to their foundations. But the atmosphere has limits, and so does your control over it. Small-scale wind manipulation is easy and precise, while enormous weather alterations require increasing amounts of concentration and time over multiple hours.

objects.title: Gift: Helios
objects.text:
The sun is a furnace of unimaginable energy that bathes entire worlds in light and heat. This ability transforms your body into a miniature stellar phenomenon, allowing you to awaken the same principles that govern the celestial furnace above. At will, your body may ignite into a temporary state of controlled stellar combustion like our own sun.

The simplest expression of this gift is flight and pyrokinesis. By releasing controlled bursts of solar energy beneath yourself, you may propel your body through the sky at extreme speeds, leaving trails of burning air behind you and by condensing the solar flares, you may release bursts of these flames out at will to destroy entire houses at once or condense the heat into single touch can melt through anything or by concentrating the radiation around yourself, you can become almost untouchable by burning of most harm that comes your way with ease.

While your radiation does not possess the lethal effects of true cosmic radiation, the uncontrolled energy output from your body creates an expanding zone of extreme heat and sickness 200 meters around you. Staying near you becomes unbearable as temperatures rises the longer you stay transformed, forcing you to revert back continuously every 5 minutes to reset your temperature for both your and other's safety.

objects.title: Gift: Jörmungandr
objects.text:
Your mouth becomes the source of the Black Tide, a supernatural water that pours from your body in enormous quantities. It can be expelled as a concentrated torrent at extreme velocity, powerful enough to cut through most metals and carve into structures like a gigantic hydro-cutting jet. You can vary the output from a narrow, high-pressure stream to a wide flood, allowing you to rapidly fill up an area with this water.

The water continues spreading until it reaches roughly one hundred metres from you. Beyond that boundary, it simply stops advancing, allowing you to rapidly build an artificial sea around yourself within a few dozen minutes. The water absorbs light rather than reflecting it, creating an unnatural darkness within it. You and anyone else can see and move through it freely even while submerged, but the experience is deeply unsettling for the water negates most of your senses when submerged.

Once the Tide reaches a depth of roughly twenty metres, you may invoke its true purpose and assume form of The World serpent. Your body transforms into an enormous serpent of approximately 6.3 km, sustained entirely by the supernatural sea beneath it that has become depthless to physically let you exist. It continuously consumes the Black Tide as fuel, exhausting the accumulated water in roughly six minutes and then an hour of cooldown.

objects.title: Gift: Absolute Zero
objects.text:
Heat is merely motion. By exerting your will upon the negative end of the thermal spectrum, you may draw kinetic energy out of the world itself. From this stolen heat you may freely create and command immense quantities of frost, ice and cold across a radius of nearly one hundred metres.

The most obvious use is the creation and manipulation of ice. Glaciers erupt from the earth in an instant, jagged spears burst through roads and buildings, walls of crystal ice for your protection, while blizzards and freezing fog rapidly consume entire battlefields. Snow may be gathered into dense clouds that cushion impacts. Every construct remains under your telekinetic control, allowing you to reshape, launch or collapse them at will.

Cold cannot exist without somewhere for the heat to go and your body serves as that reservoir. The thermal energy you remove must be stored before it can gradually bleed back into the environment. While minor techniques are effortless, sustained blizzards, colossal glaciers or prolonged battlefield-wide freezing gradually saturate you with stolen thermal energy and starts overheating beyond physiological ability to contain it despite additional mutations granted to store excessive heat. Your own control over ice starts to falter as you enter into a state of heat-stroke from sheer heat collected from sustained reckless depletion of thermal energy.

objects.text:
Your skeleton has become a living organ of perpetual growth, capable of restructuring itself in ways no natural biology should allow. Every bone in your body exists in a state of accelerated cellular activity, constantly producing an impossibly durable mineral-organic composite that can be shaped and directed entirely by your will.

You may trigger localized growth anywhere within your skeleton. Entire lengths of bone can erupt from your arms, shoulders, spine or fingertips in a completely painless process, emerging in whatever shape you want. Razor-sharp blades, crushing hammers, reinforced gauntlets, Shields, Spears and much more, they possess tremendous structural integrity and can withstand impacts that would shatter conventional steel.

Your control does not end once the bone leaves your body. Every piece remains weakly connected through a supernatural telekinetic field for some time, allowing you to suspend floating bone fragments around yourself as defensive barriers or manipulate entire masses as a swarm for overwhelming your oppoents, A single spike can be fired with enough force to punch clean through reinforced steel if you focus on it. Prolonged growth of skeleton will exhaust your own skeleton, forcing the ability to go on cooldown for 5 minutes till it recovers.

objects.title: Gift: Hemomancy
objects.text:
Your body abandons the ordinary limits of life and death. Every cell is driven by an overwhelming instinct to restore itself, rebuilding damaged tissue with frightening speed no matter how catastrophic the injury. Bullet wounds seal almost as quickly as they appear, shattered bones knit themselves together within moments, severed limbs regenerate in roughly five seconds, and even complete dismemberment is little more than an inconvenience.

This overwhelming regenerative force also allows you to weaponize your own body in ways no ordinary organism could survive. By violently increasing your internal blood pressure, Blood may be expelled through self-created ruptures anywhere across your body before the wounds instantly heal shut again. A burst from your feet launches you forward with explosive acceleration, propelling you through the air. Fingers may be fired like shotgun rounds before regenerating almost instantly.

Despite its frightening speed, your regeneration is not limitless. Every wound is rebuilt from supernatural reserves, which has a finite capacity that gets gradually filled when you rest and eat. Minor injuries are practically effortless, but replacing entire limbs or recovering from repeated fatal injuries rapidly depletes these reserves. As they diminish, regeneration slows from seconds to minutes and drop off in potency soon enough.

objects.title: Gift: Blind Spot
objects.text:
By invoking this ability, you force a localized quantum instability into existence within a 5m radius. Matter caught within this field momentarily loses the certainty of its exact position, causing them to appear to flicker, jitter and briefly occupy several nearby positions at once before settling again. These distortions are purely visual, but they make judging movement extraordinarily difficult especially in combat.

This instability is merely a side effect. Whenever you remain completely unobserved for at least 1.42 seconds, your own existence enters an unresolved state. Rather than occupying a single location, you become a cloud of overlapping possibilities that exists at all locations within roughly 100 meters that is likewise free from observation, You can collapse this uncertainty at will and manifest at any of these unobserved locations.

By refusing to collapse into a single location, you may instead allow your unresolved possibilities to persist temporarily as many phantom existence. These unrealized versions of yourself instinctively explore their surroundings, opening doors, checking corners, climbing staircases, look at hidden locations, peering through windows and following any path that could naturally be taken by you. All the knowledge is compressed into your brain granting effective clairvoyance within a 100m radius.

objects.title: Gift: Act of God
objects.text:
Your power restores an abandoned scientific idea to reality.

Within approximately 45 meters of yourself exists an invisible medium known as Aether, a universal substance filling all space that only you can perceive and manipulate. Every physical object is immersed within it at all times, allowing you to lift, push, pull, rotate or suspend objects.

Delicate movements are just as effortless as overwhelming force, allowing you to catch falling allies, redirect projectiles, dismantle obstacles or hurl enormous masses across the battlefield. At maximum output, your control is sufficient to move weights approaching several city buses. The Aether itself may also be condensed around your own body. A thin layer acts as a cushion against impacts, dispersing punches, falls and weaker projectiles before they ever reach you. Directing those same currents beneath your feet allows controlled levitation and sustained flight.

Because the Aether behaves like a true physical medium, every action sends ripples propagating through it. Minor manipulations produce disturbances too small to notice, but moving heavier objects at high speed creates increasingly violent waves that spread throughout the surrounding space. As the medium becomes saturated with overlapping disturbances, control grows progressively less stable and weaker.

objects.title: Gift: Calculus
objects.text:
Reality is far more organized than most people realize. Every object is nothing more than countless smaller parts arranged in a very specific way. Your ability allows you to temporarily impose the mathematical concepts of differentiation and integration upon the physical world itself.

By bringing your palms within roughly 10 meters of a target, you may initiate Differentiation, causing invisible spatial fractures to propagate throughout the object. Rather than crudely slicing through matter, the ability intelligently separates structures along their natural boundaries. A brick wall effortlessly falls into individual bricks, a vehicle disassembles into thousands of perfectly separated components and even intricate machinery comes apart bolt by bolt without damaging a single piece.

Within a 10 second window, you may invoke Integration, reconstructing every differentiated component in whatever arrangement you desire, provided the available material can physically support the result. A demolished bridge may become an enormous staircase. A shattered car can be rebuilt into an armored barricade. The ability remains astonishingly precise. Individual sections of a target can be differentiated while the remainder is left untouched. The maximum value you can affect is 1200 m³, enough to cover an airplane.

objects.title: Gift: Pandora's Box
objects.text:
Certain systems eventually become so complex that even their creators no longer fully understand them. Engineers refer to these as black boxes. You know what goes in, you know what comes out, but everything happening in between is effectively unknowable. You can deliberately replicate this phenomena on your inventions you personally make.

The ability grants an overwhelming instinct for assembly. You simply know which seemingly nonsensical components belong together, often building machines that would make no sense to anyone watching. Even after finishing a device, you cannot fully explain why it functions. The power naturally favors compact technology over massive infrastructure. Handheld equipment, vehicles, drones, weapons and room-sized machinery are all within reach, but planetary superweapons or continent-spanning megaprojects remain well beyond your power. The more localized the invention, the more extraordinary its performance becomes.

Additionally, Every electronic machine possesses a faint consciousness that only you can perceive. By listening carefully, you may hold genuine conversations with nearby technology and persuade them. A surveillance camera can be convinced to divert its attention away from you. An elevator may happily skips floors for you because you simply asked nicely.

objects.title: Gift: Miasma
objects.text:
Your liver has become a living chemical foundry, capable of performing biochemical reactions impossible for ordinary life. Drawing nutrients already within your body alongside trace elements absorbed through food or prolonged physical contact, it synthesizes specialized compounds that are released through microscopic pores hidden within your palms.

The compounds themselves remain completely inert inside your body.

Only after leaving your skin do they encounter oxygen, where they rapidly undergo a chain of supernatural chemical reactions. Within seconds, the reaction stabilizes into a visible black aerosol that spreads naturally through the air, carrying whatever properties you designed into the surrounding environment and remains active for next 75 seconds before dissipating.

Sleeping gases, powerful stimulants, analgesics, tear gas, corrosive oxidizers, localized anesthetics, muscle relaxants, hallucinogens and hundreds of other specialized aerosols become possible provided they can ultimately be justified through chemistry. Production is limited by both nutrients and metabolism. Filling a room with gas is entirely practical, but producing enough to engulf large areas is impossible. Likewise, your body requires time to manufacture new compounds before they can be deployed. You aren't immune to your gases whether positive or negative in effect.

objects.title: Gift: All-Seeing Eye
objects.text:
The All-Seeing Eye is an ancient symbol of omnipresent observation, representing a gaze that watches without ever looking away. Your ability manifests this idea physically, creating up to 101 floating Nazar-beads, each remains linked to your own perception.

Each eye can travel anywhere within roughly 200 metres, allowing you to scatter them through out battlefield. They are physically durable enough to survive most impacts and can be launched as blunt projectiles capable of cracking wood, breaking glass or deliver nasty impacts that hurt a lot to anyone hit by them. Everything seen by the beads is transmitted directly into your consciousness. Your perception seamlessly integrates them into a single coherent awareness with very minor strain put upon you.

The beads can switch between normal, thermal and X-ray-like vision, allowing you to see heat signatures, identify concealed objects and observe through certain obstacles. All beads share the same vision mode, and switching between them only takes a couple seconds of time.

You may call every manifested eye back to a single location and collapse their supernatural energy into one catastrophic discharge. The beads disappear simultaneously, producing an explosion powerful enough to collapse a skyscraper at cost your power for the rest of the day.

objects.text:
Radio waves are invisible signals constantly passing through the world, carrying voices, information and images through empty space without anyone noticing them. Your nervous system has somehow become capable of generating, receiving and manipulating those signals.

The most fundamental expression of Broadcast is communication. You can emit a controlled field of radio waves from your brain and use the returning signals to establish a connection with nearby minds. Within roughly 100 metres, you can selectively tune into the thoughts of individuals around you. Broadcast can also work in the opposite direction. By directing your signal into someone's mind in range while maintaining line of sight, you can transmit suggestions directly into their thought process, to strongly influence what they do but cant alter their base personality.

Your radio sense also extends naturally to technology. You can transmit your voice through nearby speakers, radios, phones and other communication devices without physically using them and use the ability in reverse to eavesdrop via the same technology. Excessive transmission rapidly exhausts you, particularly when simultaneously reading minds, controlling suggestions and interfering with electronics. Pushing the power too far can force the entire ability into a five minute cooldown.

objects.text:
Your liver has become a living chemical foundry, capable of performing biochemical reactions impossible for ordinary life. objects.text:
By invoking this ability, you force a localized quantum instability into existence within a 5m radius. Matter caught within this field momentarily loses the certainty of its exact position, causing them to appear to flicker, jitter and briefly occupy several nearby positions at once before settling again. These distortions are purely visual, but they make judging movement extraordinarily difficult especially in combat. This instability is merely a side effect. Whenever you remain completely unobserved for at least 1.42 seconds, your own existence enters an unresolved state. Rather than occupying a single location, you become a cloud of overlapping possibilities that exists at all locations within roughly 100 meters that is likewise free from observation, You can collapse this uncertainty at will and manifest at any of these unobserved locations.

By refusing to collapse into a single location, you may instead allow your unresolved possibilities to persist temporarily as many phantom existence. These unrealized versions of yourself instinctively explore their surroundings, opening doors, checking corners, climbing staircases, look at hidden locations, peering through windows and following any path that could naturally be taken by you. All the knowledge is compressed into your brain granting effective clairvoyance within a 100m radius.

objects.title: Gift: Dead Air
objects.text:
Your body can be reduced to smoke at will, breaking apart into a supernatural cloud while remaining completely under your control. The transformation takes only about a second, and you can also transform individual portions of yourself while leaving the rest physical.

While dispersed, you retain control over every part of yourself. You can fly, change direction in midair and reform yourself anywhere within your dispersed mass. You also gain a crude sense of your surroundings through disturbances in the smoke, allowing you to detect movement and nearby objects even without eyes. You can compress portions of yourself into dense pockets and violently release them, producing localized bursts of pressure that function like smoke bullets.

You can also rapidly expand your body into a massive smoke screen, filling an area of roughly eighty meters to obscure vision. The smoke itself is unnaturally cold. It continuously draws thermal energy from whatever it surrounds, causing surfaces and objects within it to rapidly lose heat. With sustained exposure, severe hypothermia can develop within a few minutes. The more dispersed you become, The harder it is to maintain precise control and awareness, thus you cannot maintain smoke form for more than 5 minutes and need 25 seconds cooldown to use it again

objects.title: Gift: Intrusion
objects.text:
Every living creature creates a presence. A subtle collection of signals that tells others where you are, what you feel and whether you should be considered a threat or not. Most people cannot consciously perceive it, but their instincts constantly evaluate and react to presence of others. Your ability gives you complete control over this invisible impression.

The simplest application is suppression. By reducing every signal your body produces, you can make yourself extraordinarily easy to overlook. Your existence becomes something the human mind struggles to prioritize. People can still see you but unless something forces them to focus on you, their brain naturally dismisses you. In a crowded street, a dark hallway or a room full of distractions, you are effectively invisible.

The opposite expression of this ability is far more frightening. By projecting your hostility, intent and killing instinct outward, you can create an overwhelming psychological pressure that awakens fear response. Their heart races, muscles tense and breathing becomes difficult. Some experience vivid images of their own death, seeing hallucinations their mind created from the sheer dread. This projection can affect an area up to roughly 60m around you, though maintaining such a powerful presence requires concentration especially against superior roles.

objects.title: Gift: Command Chain
objects.text:
At your command, 30 supernatural chains total erupt from specialized gateways located within your palms and mouth. Once fired, every chain remains connected to your nervous system, granting you precise control over them, obeying your will as naturally as your own limbs, twisting, coiling and changing direction through the air. A chain may lash outward as a whip, quietly snake across the ground or weave through narrow openings before whipping as you will it.

Each chain's hooked tip embeds itself into nearly any surface, allowing you to swing across cities, instantly change direction in midair and due to supernatural origin lets you drag objects has heavy as 200Kg with ease or act as shield to protect from most conventional firearms.

Among the dozens of ordinary chains exists a special chain known only as the King's Chain marked by a snake like end. Should the it pierce the base of a target's neck, It establishes a direct connection with their nervous system. From that moment onward, the victim's body becomes subject to your commands for the next 45 minutes. They remain fully conscious throughout the entire process, able to think but cannot control their body from obeying your commands. The connection remains active until you willingly release it or 45 minutes have passed or the chain is melted off.

objects.title: Gift: Akasha
objects.text:
To you, the sky is not empty space, but an immense invisible structure stretching endlessly above the world. Through your will alone, you may grasp, stretch, compress and fold this celestial layer as if its an elastic layer.

The simplest application is movement. Pulling downward upon the sky draws your body upward with equal force, launching you effortlessly into the air. By repeatedly stretching and releasing sky behind yourself, you generate continuous propulsion. Likewise, sections of the sky can be stretched beneath your feet, forming invisible platforms capable of supporting your weight, granting ability to levitate above ground.

Folding the sky causes nearby space to fold with it. Distances of dozen meters may be compressed, allowing you to cross such length in only a few steps or redirect harm away from you if you react in time. The same principle works in reverse. By stretching a section of the sky, you force space beneath it to lengthen more than it actually is. Every time you rapidly stretch, twist or snap the celestial membrane, the atmosphere is inevitably dragged along with it. A sudden snap of sky sends powerful arcs of compressed wind racing forward, capable of cleaving through stone. By continuously twisting a localized section of the sky, you may stir it into compact whirlwinds that grow into powerful short-lived tornadoes.

objects.text:
The universe is ultimately formless. Every colour, face and shape is merely a veil draped over a deeper reality, allowing the infinite to be perceived as something finite. This cosmic principle is known as Māyā, the great veil that grants existence its visible form. Your gift grants dominion over these veils, allowing you to loosen, weave and replace them at will.

The simplest expression of this authority is to draw the Veil of Perfection over yourself. Your appearance transcends mortal beauty, becoming so unnaturally flawless that it borders on the divine. Those who gaze upon you find their judgement clouded. Critical thinking dulls, Hostility softens and people become noticeably more receptive to your suggestions and requests, often overlooking any suspicion they have.

Within a radius of roughly 80 metres, you may project illusions so complete they are almost impossible to distinguish from genuine existence. Empty streets fill with bustling crowds or ruined buildings may appear untouched . These illusions possess convincing sight and sound, remaining perfectly consistent regardless of lighting or viewing angle. The illusions possess no physical substance and cannot directly harm anything, but they are extremely convincing. However, they need to be reasonable to the area otherwise people can see through them and nullify their power.

objects.text:
Legends speak of fox spirits so ancient and cunning that they eventually abandoned their bestial forms altogether, learning to walk among mankind beneath borrowed faces. Wherever such spirits wander, they are accompanied by the Kitsune-bi, ethereal foxfires said to contain their soul.

They may drift freely within roughly 30m, hover motionless in the air or be hurled as an explosive projectile, erupting into supernatural flame capable of scorching flesh. Despite their ghostly nature, the foxfires can also be momentarily compressed into solid constructs capable of supporting your weight. These floating footholds can allow you to walk on air.

Having personally met someone, you may devote any number of foxfires to assuming their identity. The transformation flawlessly reproduces their appearance, voice, scent and countless unconscious details. Every foxfire invested commits roughly one fifth of your spiritual essence to sustaining that identity, making the imitation progressively more convincing. Four foxfires are widely considered the ideal balance, producing an imitation realistic enough to deceive close friends while still leaving one foxfire available for combat and escape. Should all five foxfires be devoted to the disguise, Your spirit begins unconsciously reconstructing the person you imitate granting even their memories to some extent.

objects.title: Gift: Curtain call
objects.text:
Your gift allows you to briefly impose the invisible laws of theater upon reality, causing the world within 50m radius from you to act like a directed performance. Within this stage, theatrics becomes a tangible phenomena manifesting as many distinct supernatural effects for you to invoke at will.

The first is the Spotlight. At will, you may cast spotlight upon anything within sight, declaring it the focus of the scene. The target can never truly hide from now on, even if they go beyond your range of 50m. Walls, darkness, smoke and obstacles no longer hide their location. The spotlight can be intensified to cause a gradual heating effect on target too.

The second is Intermission. Once every 3 minutes, you may abruptly call for an intermission, forcing the flow of time within the range of the stage to be halted for upto 5 seconds for everything except for you, letting you freely reposition yourself to evade dangerous strikes or attack your opponents within this precious window of vulnerability.

objects.text:
Every enclosed place, whether it be a Room, elevators, cave, a shipping container, a bunker or even the inside of a wardrobe, is defined by a closed boundary. Your power allows you to seize complete control over the Euclidean geometry contained within that boundary while leaving the exterior completely unchanged. The moment you become fully enclosed, the surrounding space becomes yours to rewrite.

A small room may unfold into labyrinth stretching for kilometers despite being far smaller on outside. Corridors may branch into new locations that never physically existed, a door may connect two separate rooms. Staircases may climb sideways and ceilings may become walkable ground. Should someone pursue you, corridors elongate until there is infinite distance between you and them. Walls may rearrange to form barricades while floor can rotate to throw everything off-balance.

Although the exact phenomena remain partially spontaneous, your subconscious continuously guides the distortion toward outcomes favorable to you. More importantly, you instinctively have an understanding of your own domain, Knowing how the liminal space works. The ability isn't truly infinite in its scale but amplifies the available space, Excessive shifting within shorter window forces a cooldown of 5 minutes on user.

objects.text:
Certain systems eventually become so complex that even their creators no longer fully understand them. Engineers refer to these as black boxes. You know what goes in, you know what comes out, but everything happening in between is effectively unknowable. You can deliberately replicate this phenomena on your inventions you personally make.

The ability grants an overwhelming instinct for assembly. You simply know which seemingly nonsensical components belong together, often building machines that would make no sense to anyone watching. Even after finishing a device, you cannot fully explain why it functions. The power naturally favors compact technology over massive infrastructure. Handheld equipment, vehicles, drones, weapons and room-sized machinery are all within reach, but planetary superweapons or continent-spanning megaprojects remain well beyond your power. The more localized the invention, the more extraordinary its performance becomes.

A surveillance camera can be convinced to divert its attention away from you. An elevator may happily skips floors for you because you simply asked nicely.

objects.text:
Stories possess a peculiar habit of rewarding the prepared. Your gift manifests this same narrative principle within reality, granting you an uncanny intuition for objects whose importance has yet to reveal itself. At any moment when you enter a new environment, your instincts quietly draw your attention toward seemingly ordinary items that will become unexpectedly useful in the near future. Exactly how or when they will matter is never revealed. Whether they become the deciding factor in a battle, an escape or defense is entirely up to you. The power hands merely you the loaded gun, but only you decide when to pull the trigger.

When an object identified by your intuition is employed at precisely the right moment, coincidence begins bending in your favour. Small actions that cascade into disproportionately larger consequences due to amplification of chaos theory, Situations unfolding in the most advantageous way possible because you nudged it at the perfect time.

Your nervous system has been transformed into a biological superconductor, allowing electrical impulses to travel through your body with virtually no resistance. The most immediate effect is speed bordering on the inhuman. Even for extended periods, you can comfortably maintain speeds approaching 300 kilometers per hour while your perception and reflexes accelerate enough to barely process movement at those velocities. When absolute performance is required, your nervous system may enter a temporary Overdrive state. During these brief bursts, your acceleration can momentarily reach speeds comparable to a bullet train.

The immense electrical potential generated by your nervous system naturally overflows beyond your skin, allowing you to project it into the surrounding environment for variety of offensive and defensive uses. Although your nervous system conducts electricity with ease, the rest of your body must still endure the immense heat generated by operating at such extremes. Long periods of movement gradually raises your internal temperature, making prolonged use increasingly exhausting.

objects.text:
Your body is surrounded by a localized gravitational field that no longer obeys the planet beneath your feet. Within a controllable radius of upto 50 meters, you may locally redefine how gravitational fields behave by simply assigning your own feet as the new 'down'. For wherever your feet point will be the new direction from which gravity will act within the radius.

Its simplest application is upon yourself. You may sprint across walls or rapidly change your orientation to gain bursts of impossible mobility. By extending your field outward, you may impose new directions of gravity upon everything caught within it. Entire groups of enemies may suddenly be hurled sideways into buildings or be dragged upward toward the sky until they leave the range.

By placing both palms upon a non-living object, you may designate it as the temporary centre of gravity for everything within your field and The world begins collapsing toward it. Rubble, vehicles, weapons and unfortunate opponents are violently dragged inward, crashing together under immense force for the next 5.54 secs. Your body is enveloped by a thin gravitational field that curves the trajectories of low-threat objects like rain, small debris away from you. objects.text:
Fire has always represented more than destruction. Before it was a weapon, it was the first tool of mankind. It was warmth in the cold, light in the darkness, and the force that allowed humanity to shape the world around them. Your body houses a fragment of that primordial fire.

Your body becomes a source of divine flame, allowing you to summon it from your hands. Unlike ordinary fire, these flames are a manifestation of user's own will, A supernatural combustion that grows stronger as their determination, conviction and purpose intensify. The flame responds naturally to your control, allowing you to shape and manipulate it through pyrokinesis. You may release it as concentrated streams, spread it into walls, wrap your limbs in flame to enhance strikes, or create controlled bursts beneath yourself for limited propulsions.

The sacred fire of Prometheus was not given to humanity to burn the world, but to transform it. By placing their hands upon metal, the user may transfer their supernatural heat into the material, rapidly superheating it until it reaches a malleable state. Once softened, The user can manipulate its shape through their will, bending and reforming it into different form. A sword may be reforged into a spear. A damaged machine may be repaired. Metal rapidly cool down once you stop using your gift.

objects.title: Gift: Black Cat
objects.text:
Black cats have carried the reputation of an omen for centuries, associated with accidents and misfortune. This ability turns that superstition into a real phenomenon, placing you at the center of an unfair imbalance of luck. When activated, a faint black aura begins crawling across your body, accompanied by a distant, loud meow that seems to echo from every direction. The sound is the only warning that the phenomenon has begun.

While active for the next seven minutes, your luck becomes extraordinarily powerful, but only under one condition: you must stop thinking about surviving. As long as you act without hesitation, caution or fear, probability begins bending in your favor. You can walk through traffic without looking or an active battlefield and all events will arrange themselves to never harm you, projectiles miss, weapons jam or structures collapse randomly.

The effect becomes dramatically weaker the moment you begin consciously protecting yourself or deliberately make "safe" decisions. Your good fortune is not created from nothing. The phenomenon effectively redistributes probability, stealing favorable outcomes from the world around you and concentrating them upon yourself. The worse the danger you casually survive, the more violently misfortune accumulates over everything else, bestowing misfortune and accidents to the world around you in your stead.

objects.title: Gift: Hemomancy
objects.text:
Your body abandons the ordinary limits of life and death. Every cell is driven by an overwhelming instinct to restore itself, rebuilding damaged tissue with frightening speed no matter how catastrophic the injury. Bullet wounds seal almost as quickly as they appear, shattered bones knit themselves together within moments, severed limbs regenerate in roughly five seconds, and even complete dismemberment is little more than an inconvenience.

This overwhelming regenerative force also allows you to weaponize your own body in ways no ordinary organism could survive. By violently increasing your internal blood pressure, Blood may be expelled through self-created ruptures anywhere across your body before the wounds instantly heal shut again. A burst from your feet launches you forward with explosive acceleration, propelling you through the air. Fingers may be fired like shotgun rounds before regenerating almost instantly.

Despite its frightening speed, your regeneration is not limitless. Every wound is rebuilt from supernatural reserves, which has a finite capacity that gets gradually filled when you rest and eat. Minor injuries are practically effortless, but replacing entire limbs or recovering from repeated fatal injuries rapidly depletes these reserves. As they diminish, regeneration slows from seconds to minutes and drop off in potency soon enough.

objects.title: Gift: Alter Ego
objects.text:
Sigmund Freud's model of the mind divided human psychology into three competing forces: the Id, driven by immediate desire, Ego responsible for navigating reality and Superego, representing ideals, morality and the image of what a person believes they should become.

You may manifest three luminous psychic orbs, each representing one aspect of the mind. The orbs themselves are harmless, but by pressing one into a person, you can temporarily push their consciousness toward the corresponding state. The effect can be used on yourself or others, allowing you to deliberately change the way a mind approaches a situation.

Id strips away hesitation and floods the target with primal instinct, granting supernatural physicality and aggression for combat or escaping danger.

Ego instead pushes the mind toward pure reasoning and intellect, enhancing perception, deduction and problem-solving.

Superego forces the subject toward their own idealized conception of perfection, Optimized according to what they believe they are supposed to be and suppressing weakness at cost of utter detachment from humanity.

However, the three states are fundamentally incompatible. Attempting to implant multiple orbs into the same person causes the conflicting mental processes to fight for control and leaves them paralyzed.

objects.title: Gift: Bifröst
objects.text:
In Norse mythology, the Bifröst is the burning rainbow bridge connecting the world of mankind to the realm of the gods. Your power manifests this legendary bridge as a concentrated column of supernatural rainbow energy descending from the sky. When called upon for transportation, the Bifröst forms a circular field roughly ten metres across, allowing you and anyone within it to be lifted away and deposited at any location within one kilometre. The journey is effectively instantaneous, making it useful for escaping attacks or for traveling large distances.

The same phenomenon can be used offensively. Bifröst can be directly onto a target or structure. The descending beam exerts tremendous pressure upon everything caught beneath it, crushing and forcing the affected area downward until it collapses. The full-strength version requires several seconds to form, and announces itself with an increasingly bright column of rainbow light. You may call a faster variant by sacrificing roughly three quarters of its destructive force for almost immediate deployment. It is far less devastating, but much harder to evade.

The ability has also permanently enhanced your hearing to roughly three times ordinary human sensitivity, allowing you to detect distant movement and subtle sounds that are beyond human capability.

objects.title: Gift: Seraphim
objects.text:
Seraphim are among the highest beings described in Abrahamic religious tradition, celestial entities associated with God's presence and holiness and depicted with six wings, your gift allows you to manifest that imagery.

At will, six pairs of enormous wings may unfold from your back, giving you a total of twelve wings. Despite their size, they remain remarkably light and can propel you through the air at speeds approaching 200 km/h, while retaining enough control for sharp turns, rapid dives and sudden changes in direction. The wings themselves possess considerable supernatural durability, capable of absorbing sustained firearm fire and protecting your body from impacts that would normally be fatal. Each wing bears multiple eyes, giving you complete awareness of your surroundings.

Once every hour, you may release a Wave of Grace.

The wave spreads outward from you and affects those who genuinely possess religious faith. Rather than physically attacking them, it overwhelms the foundation of that belief. Those caught within it experience an impossible vision of divine presence, something their minds interpret as an encounter with God itself. The experience is so overwhelming that most affected individuals collapse to their knees, unable to process what they are witnessing. For several minutes afterward, they remain effectively comatose.

objects.text:
The Mandela Effect describes the strange phenomenon of large numbers of people remembering events that never happened, as though reality itself had somehow been edited and replaced by another version. Your ability turns that idea into something real. You cannot freely rewrite history, but you can force reality to accept a slightly different version of the past.

Within roughly twenty seconds of the present, you may create a localized revision of your own actions. You may select a moment from your personal timeline and replace what you actually did with another action you could physically have performed at that time. If you were struck by a punch, you can revise the event so that you dodged it instead. If you missed an attack, you can revise yourself into having taken the correct angle and landed it. The revision only concerns your own actions. You cannot rewrite another person's decisions or use resources you didn't had at that point of time. The further a revision would ripple beyond your current circumstances, the more difficult it becomes until the ability simply rejects it.

Your physical attacks possess a smaller manifestation of the same phenomenon. Every physical blow you personally land produces up to four additional false impacts. These false strikes carry real force despite having no visible source, appearing from different directions around the target.

objects.title: Gift: Mandela Effect
objects.text:
The Mandela Effect describes the strange phenomenon of large numbers of people remembering events that never happened, as though reality itself had somehow been edited and replaced by another version. Your ability turns that idea into something real. You cannot freely rewrite history, but you can force reality to accept a slightly different version of the past.

Within roughly 50 seconds of the present, you may create a localized revision of your own actions. You may select a moment from your personal timeline and replace what you actually did with another action you could physically have performed at that time. If you were struck by a punch, you can revise the event so that you dodged it instead. If you missed an attack, you can revise yourself into having taken the correct angle and landed it. The revision only concerns your own actions. You cannot rewrite another person's decisions or use resources you didn't had at that point of time. The further a revision would ripple beyond your current circumstances, the more difficult it becomes until the ability simply rejects it.

Your physical attacks possess a smaller manifestation of the same phenomenon. Every physical blow you personally land produces up to six additional false impacts. These false strikes carry real force despite having no visible source, appearing from different directions around the target.

objects.title: Gift: Māyā
objects.text:
The universe is ultimately formless. Every colour, face and shape is merely a veil draped over a deeper reality, allowing the infinite to be perceived as something finite. This cosmic principle is known as Māyā, the great veil that grants existence its visible form. Your gift grants dominion over these veils, allowing you to loosen, weave and replace them at will.

The simplest expression of this authority is to draw the Veil of Perfection over yourself. Your appearance transcends mortal beauty, becoming so unnaturally flawless that it borders on the divine. Those who gaze upon you find their judgement clouded. Critical thinking dulls, Hostility softens and people become noticeably more receptive to your suggestions and requests, often overlooking any suspicion they have.

Within a radius of roughly 80 metres, you may project illusions so complete they are almost impossible to distinguish from genuine existence. Empty streets fill with bustling crowds or ruined buildings may appear untouched . These illusions possess convincing sight and sound, remaining perfectly consistent regardless of lighting or viewing angle. The illusions possess no physical substance and cannot directly harm anything, but they are extremely convincing. However, they need to be reasonable to the area otherwise people can see through them and nullify their power.

objects.title: Gift: Exposure
objects.text:
This ability forces the logic of photography into reality. A photograph is a moment removed from the continuous flow of the world, flattened into something that can be observed long after the original moment has passed. Your power takes that principle literally, allowing you to capture moments and temporarily remove them from reality.

The simplest expression is the Freeze Frame. By snapping your fingers while targeting something within roughly 25 metres, you can capture an object no larger than a car and collapse it into a perfectly flat, two-dimensional pane of supernatural glass. The resulting frame is extraordinarily durable and weighs as light as paper. You can hold it as a shield, use it as a solid platform or throw it like a heavy glass projectile you can throw. A Freeze Frame lasts for up to ten seconds. When the duration expires, the photograph shatters into light and the original object is restored where its frame is.

But photography has another meaning: capturing a moment itself. By producing a blinding flash through a clap, you can create a Snapshot, freezing the flow of time around you for up to three seconds. Everything except you becomes completely motionless. The temporal freeze places enormous strain on the ability, forcing a recovery period of roughly 75 seconds before another full Snapshot can be performed.

objects.title: Gift: Dreamcatcher
objects.text:
Modern neuroscience still cannot fully explain why dreaming exists. During REM sleep, the brain becomes one of the most active organs in the human body, constructing entire worlds while remaining disconnected from external reality. Your power exploits that phenomenon, treating dreams as a genuine layer of existence produced whenever a conscious mind enters REM sleep.

The most fundamental expression of this gift is Dreamwalking. Any person sleeping within the range of an entire city can be dreamwalked into. Upon doing so, your physical body vanishes from reality, its existence temporarily transferred into the dream itself. You possess overwhelming authority within dreams. You may summon people from dreamer's memory, landscapes may shift at your whim, or construct elaborate scenarios to comfort, question or terrify them. You are capable of interrogation, private conversations or see into people's trauma and memories to comfort them.

Outside the dream world, the same authority manifests through the phenomenon of REM sleep. By striking the back of a person's neck, you may forcibly induce REM activity while they remain completely conscious. Over the following seconds, voluntary movement gradually disappears as REM atonia spreads throughout their body effectively paralyzing them for the next minute all while they are hallucinating.

objects.title: Gift: Martial Law
objects.text:
Your power allows you to impose martial law upon a designated area. The ability is activated by throwing a small pin. Wherever the pin lands becomes the center of your jurisdiction, establishing a 50-metre radius zone in which disorder itself becomes difficult to sustain. The Zone imposes a mental pressure toward order and compliance.

Should the situation refuses to settle, you may formally escalate the zone into Riot Control and gain access to these 3 abilities:

  • Barricade creates solid energy shields at chosen points throughout your territory. They can appear between you and an incoming attack, surround allies or block entrances. Their durability is immense, capable of absorbing superhuman strikes before eventually collapsing.

  • Tear Gas allows you to designate a small area and fill it with a concentrated cloud of powerful irritant. It cannot be continuously produced, once every 10 minutes only.

  • Water Hose lets you form a finger-gun with either hand and fire compressed bursts of water. It comes out as high-pressure impacts, capable of knocking people backward, deflecting lighter projectiles or even shoving vehicles aside but is unable to cause serious harm.

objects.title: Gift: Paper trail
objects.text:
You can manifest and control paper within a radius of roughly 80 metres, creating anything from ordinary sheets to larger commercially available formats. Every sheet responds directly to your thoughts, allowing you to command thousands of pieces simultaneously and move them at remarkable speeds. Individually, paper is still just paper. Your power comes from what you can do with enormous quantities of it.

Sheets can be layered together to create surprisingly sturdy barriers, folded and compressed into dense masses, or wrapped around objects and people to restrain them. You can soak the paper into heavy pulp and manipulate the mass as a blunt weapon, or unleash thousands of sheets simultaneously as a violent storm to shred weaker materials. You can maintain enough paper to overwhelm sections of a building, but the total amount you can keep manifested is finite and will exhaust your mental stamina at larger quantities.

By physically attaching one of your papers to an object, you can use it as a medium for psychometry. The paper begins recording fragments of the object's recent history, manifesting them as written logs, diagrams and crude pointers across its surface. You can investigate where an object has been, what has happened around it and which events it has recently been involved in, reaching back as far as twenty hours.

objects.title: Gift: All-Seeing Eye
objects.text:
The All-Seeing Eye is an ancient symbol of omnipresent observation, representing a gaze that watches without ever looking away. Your ability manifests this idea physically, creating up to 101 floating Nazar-beads, each remains linked to your own perception.

Each eye can travel anywhere within roughly 200 metres, allowing you to scatter them through out battlefield. They are physically durable enough to survive most impacts and can be launched as blunt projectiles capable of cracking wood, breaking glass or deliver nasty impacts that hurt a lot to anyone hit by them. Everything seen by the beads is transmitted directly into your consciousness. Your perception seamlessly integrates them into a single coherent awareness with very minor strain put upon you.

The beads can switch between normal, thermal and X-ray-like vision, allowing you to see heat signatures, identify concealed objects and observe through certain obstacles. All beads share the same vision mode, and switching between them only takes a couple seconds of time.

You may call every manifested eye back to a single location and collapse their supernatural energy into one catastrophic discharge. The beads disappear simultaneously, producing an explosion powerful enough to collapse a skyscraper at cost your power for the rest of the day.

objects.title: Gift: Act of God
objects.text:
Your power restores an abandoned scientific idea to reality.

Within approximately 55 meters of yourself exists an invisible medium known as Aether, a universal substance filling all space that only you can perceive and manipulate. Every physical object is immersed within it at all times, allowing you to lift, push, pull, rotate or suspend objects.

Delicate movements are just as effortless as overwhelming force, allowing you to catch falling allies, redirect projectiles, dismantle obstacles or hurl enormous masses across the battlefield. At maximum output, your control is sufficient to move weights approaching several city buses. The Aether itself may also be condensed around your own body. A thin layer acts as a cushion against impacts, dispersing punches, falls and weaker projectiles before they ever reach you. Directing those same currents beneath your feet allows controlled levitation and sustained flight.

Because the Aether behaves like a true physical medium, every action sends ripples propagating through it. Minor manipulations produce disturbances too small to notice, but moving heavier objects at high speed creates increasingly violent waves that spread throughout the surrounding space. As the medium becomes saturated with overlapping disturbances, control grows progressively less stable and weaker.

objects.title: Gift: Vacancy
objects.text:
Reality is not only defined by what exists. It is equally shaped by what does not. Artists call it negative space: the empty regions surrounding and separating objects, the absence that gives form meaning. Your ability allows you to interact with these forgotten spaces, manipulating the gaps hidden throughout the physical world. The simplest expression of this ability lets your body occupies the gaps between matter instead of fully existing inside the same space as everything around you.

The result is a state of partial existence that lets you walk through matter. You remain anchored enough to stand on the ground, move normally and perceive your surroundings. In fact, while partially existing, your movement becomes significantly faster as there is less physical resistance restricting your body, allowing you to move at roughly twice your normal speed.

All matter contains enormous amounts of empty space between its atoms. Your can exploit those spaces, temporarily placing objects within the unused volume of another object, letting you "stack" multiple objects, allowing them to share the same physical space and switch them at will. A knife, a pen and a hammer may occupy the same physical space, allowing you to switch between them instantly at will. The only limitation is volume. The object being stored must fit within the available empty space of its host.

objects.title: Gift: Tempest
objects.text:
Wind is the movement of air caused by differences in pressure, temperature and density. Most of the time, those forces produce nothing more dramatic than a breeze. But when enough air begins moving in the same direction, the energy involved becomes enormous. A storm is simply the atmosphere organizing that energy into something violent.

Your ability allows you to interfere directly with those atmospheric movements. Within your range of 100m, you can increase, redirect and organize the motion of air, creating powerful gusts capable of knocking people away, redirecting projectiles, slowing movement or launching objects through the air. By concentrating your control around yourself, you may increase air resistance to act as protection or reduce it boost your movement speed or create bursts of wind that can propel you.

By forcing opposing air currents to curve around one another, you can create a vortex and continuously feed it with additional energy. Given enough time and concentration, these vortices can become full-scale tornadoes capable of ripping apart entire cities down to their foundations. But the atmosphere has limits, and so does your control over it. Small-scale wind manipulation is easy and precise, while enormous weather alterations require increasing amounts of concentration and time over an hour.

objects.title: Gift: Black Cat
objects.text:
Black cats have carried the reputation of an omen for centuries, associated with accidents and misfortune. This ability turns that superstition into a real phenomenon, placing you at the center of an unfair imbalance of luck. When activated, a faint black aura begins crawling across your body, accompanied by a distant, loud meow that seems to echo from every direction. The sound is the only warning that the phenomenon has begun.

While active for the next seven minutes, your luck becomes extraordinarily powerful, but only under one condition: you must stop thinking about surviving. As long as you act without hesitation, caution or fear, probability begins bending in your favor. You can walk through traffic without looking or an active battlefield and all events will arrange themselves to never harm you, projectiles miss, weapons jam or structures collapse randomly.

The effect becomes dramatically weaker the moment you begin consciously protecting yourself or deliberately make "safe" decisions. Your good fortune is not created from nothing. The phenomenon effectively redistributes probability, stealing favorable outcomes from the world around you and concentrating them upon yourself. The worse the danger you casually survive, the more violently misfortune accumulates over everything else, bestowing misfortune and accidents to the world around you in your stead.

objects.title: Gift: Cat's Cradle
objects.text:
Your body is no longer bound to a fixed shape. Every muscle, bone and organ possesses an extraordinary degree of flexibility, allowing your form to be stretched, compressed, twisted or flattened far beyond human limits without harm. Though your mass always remains constant and you cannot alter your appearance or anatomy, your body behaves more like an impossibly resilient elastic medium than rigid flesh.

An arm may extend over 40 metres to seize a distant object or be used as a whip, your entire body flattened thin enough to slip beneath narrow gaps, your legs may coil into springs before releasing in explosive leaps, or your entire body can twist into a spinning drill capable of smashing through walls. The ability is equally as powerful defensively too. Blunt impacts become dramatically less effective as your unique body simply absorbs and redistributes the force throughout its elastic structure, reducing such damage by as much as eighty percent.

Your body is not infinitely flexible. Every deformation stores increasing amounts of mechanical strain, much like an overstretched rubber band. Maintaining an unnatural shape for longer than roughly 20 seconds causes this tension to accumulate rapidly until your tissues violently recoil toward their natural configuration in a very painful manner.

objects.title: Gift: Liminal
objects.text:
Every enclosed place, whether it be a Room, elevators, cave, a shipping container, a bunker or even the inside of a wardrobe, is defined by a closed boundary. Your power allows you to seize complete control over the Euclidean geometry contained within that boundary while leaving the exterior completely unchanged. The moment you become fully enclosed, the surrounding space becomes yours to rewrite.

A small room may unfold into labyrinth stretching for kilometers despite being far smaller on outside. Corridors may branch into new locations that never physically existed, a door may connect two separate rooms. Staircases may climb sideways and ceilings may become walkable ground. Should someone pursue you, corridors elongate until there is infinite distance between you and them. Walls may rearrange to form barricades while floor can rotate to throw everything off-balance.

Although the exact phenomena remain partially spontaneous, your subconscious continuously guides the distortion toward outcomes favorable to you. More importantly, you instinctively have an understanding of your own domain, Knowing how the liminal space works. The ability isn't truly infinite in its scale but amplifies the available space, Excessive shifting within shorter window forces a cooldown of 5 minutes on user.

objects.title: Gift: Magician
objects.text:
Every great illusion is built upon three simple acts: disappearing, misdirection and assistance. Your gift transforms stage magic into genuine supernatural phenomena you may invoke, granting three supernatural techniques inspired by the oldest principles of stage magic.

Escape Artist allows you to erupt into an explosive burst of enchanted confetti at will. The colorful blast violently throws away restraints, bindings, nearby attackers and surrounding obstructions in every direction, The smoke stays up for a few seconds letting you make escape.

Shuffle manifests four enchanted playing cards, one from each suit. By placing a card upon any object, you temporarily mark it until the card is removed. At any later moment, you may instantly exchange the positions of any two marked objects regardless of distance for next hour or so.

Assistant summons a life-sized wooden mannequin that faithfully carries out your commands with tireless precision. Though incapable of speech or independent thought, it obediently follows straightforward commands with the competence of an average adult. It can fight, carry equipment, operate simple machinery, create distractions, rescue allies, a decoy or accompany you in hand to hand combat, it takes a day to regenerate if destroyed.

objects.title: Gift: Newton
objects.text:
Your body is surrounded by a localized gravitational field that no longer obeys the planet beneath your feet. Within a controllable radius of upto 50 meters, you may locally redefine how gravitational fields behave by simply assigning your own feet as the new 'down'. For wherever your feet point will be the new direction from which gravity will act within the radius.

Its simplest application is upon yourself. You may sprint across walls or rapidly change your orientation to gain bursts of impossible mobility. By extending your field outward, you may impose new directions of gravity upon everything caught within it. Entire groups of enemies may suddenly be hurled sideways into buildings or be dragged upward toward the sky until they leave the range.

By placing both palms upon a non-living object, you may designate it as the temporary centre of gravity for everything within your field and The world begins collapsing toward it. Rubble, vehicles, weapons and unfortunate opponents are violently dragged inward, crashing together under immense force for the next 5.54 secs. Your body is enveloped by a thin gravitational field that curves the trajectories of low-threat objects like rain, small debris away from you. Each major application requires 2 seconds of cooldown period before switching into the next one.

objects.title: Gift: Déjà Vu
objects.text:
Time normally moves as an irreversible sequence of cause and effect. Your gift lets you challenge that order, By selecting a moment as an anchor, you create a localized temporal loop lasting exactly 25 seconds. Once that duration expires, reality immediately returns to the chosen starting point, repeating the same loop once more.

The loop itself is absolute. Objects, people and the environment all return precisely to the state they possessed when the anchor was first set. Only your memories survive the reset, accumulating naturally with each repetition. There is no limit to how many times a loop may repeat beyond your own willingness to endure it, though repeatedly living the same twenty-five seconds inevitably becomes mentally exhausting. To everyone else, every cycle is experienced as though it were the first and only time it has ever happened to them, retaining no memories of the loops.

Even outside an active loop, your perception of causality is supernatural. Whenever an event is about to place you in immediate physical danger, Your subconscious begins responding before the threat arrives. You can catch bullets and arrows on instinct, weave effortlessly through barrages and survive attacks no ordinary person could ever hope to react to. This passive ability gets drained by continuous use of loops however.
