rows.title: The Major Power
rows.titleText:
"Well then... our little star has finally discovered the Role they were always meant to play."

But a Role alone does not make for an entertaining story. I have watched kingdoms rise and fall over politics, watched wars fought over pride and greed.

Politics? Diplomacy? Ordinary people solving ordinary problems? What a dreadful waste of everyone's time.

"Believe me when I say... it gets terribly repetitive after the first few thousand years."

No, this story deserves something far more spectacular. It deserves power.

The kind that turns impossible situations into everyday inconveniences. A single gift, powerful enough to shape your identity and versatile enough to become the foundation of everything that follows. Now... Which gift has managed to capture your curiosity?

objects.title: Superior Strength
objects.text:
This grants you a substantial increase to your physical strength and durability. You can exert roughly 2 tons of force, allowing you to lift, shove, break and strike with immense power. Your body is also durable enough to withstand handgun fire, heavy impacts, falls and other hazards that would seriously injure an ordinary person.

A Gift like Akasha lets you wrap the atmosphere around your strikes for higher impact or envelope objects to make lifting them effortless. A Gift like Cat's Cradle lets you twist your rubbery body into an explosive, spring-like form to deliver hits.

objects.title: Superior Speed
objects.text:
It grants a substantial increase to your movement speed and leaping capability. You can reach speeds up to 60 km/h at a full sprint and use that momentum to leap up to 15 meters. However, your reaction speed remains unchanged, and you can only sustain a full sprint for short bursts before fatigue sets in.

Users of Absolute Zero can freeze the ground beneath them to eliminate friction and slide at top speed. With Prometheus, you can ignite a bed of flames beneath your feet, riding it like a surfboard. Baba Yaga to eliminate air around you to run faster.

objects.title: Superior Senses
objects.text:
This grants your Major Gift the ability to extend directly into your nervous system and either elevating your baseline senses: sight, hearing, touch, scent, or grants an entirely new supernatural sense through the unique medium of your power to detect your nearby environmental variables with uncanny ease.

With Act of God, you can process the subtle ripples and distortions traveling through the surrounding Aether, granting you a form of 360-degree awareness. Steamheart lets you trace thermal signatures of living organism and humidity shifts created by your venting.

objects.title: Superior Mind
objects.text:
It allows your Major Gift to extend into your own cognition, accelerating your mental processing and logical reasoning. Your capacity to learn, analyze, problem-solve, and connect abstract data is substantially improved, raising your cognition by roughly 45 IQ points above your natural baseline.

With Snapshot, you can mentally process images at blinding speed, extracting subtle details, background clues, and hidden patterns in milliseconds. With Paper Trail, you can piece together complex crime scenes and history logs effortlessly.

objects.title: Levitation
objects.text:
This grants you the ability to lift yourself off the ground and move freely through the air at speeds up to roughly 40 km/h. You can rise up to 30 meters high, allowing you to bypass ground terrain, evade attacks, and maneuver through three-dimensional space.

With Zeeman Effect, you can repel and pull yourself through the earth's magnetic field to simulate flight. With Shadow Legion, you can manifest dozens of continuous shadow limbs that are constantly handing you off to one another to emulate flight or Beelzebub can use the swarm to lift you up.

objects.title: Fabrication
objects.text:
It allows you to materialize solid, physical objects through your power's medium. These constructs are no larger than your torso and cannot consist of complex mechanisms or powered electronics. However, they are remarkably versatile, allowing you to instantly create basic weapons or utensils on the fly.

With Golconda, you can sprout sharp diamond daggers or shields directly from your skin. With Dreamcatcher, you can pull solidified dream-stuff into physical reality, forming ethereal daggers or small barriers that retain real mass.

objects.title: Premonition
objects.text:
It grants a limited ability to foresee imminent danger and receive warnings about events that have not yet occurred. At its most reliable, You can sense immediate threats within a single second, giving you a crucial moment to react. Beyond that, it can also manifest as vague omens regarding future danger.

With Broadcast, this manifests as sudden, static-heavy radio transmissions into nearby devices, playing brief audio snippets of the immediate future. With All-Seeing Eye, floating Nazar-beads will lock their gaze onto the location from where danger originates.

objects.title: Extension
objects.text:
It grants the ability to interact with and move objects within a 20-meter radius without physical contact. You can lift, carry, or operate targets weighing up to 500 kg. However, this is strictly remote interaction rather than true telekinesis: movement speeds are moderate and comparable to human handling.

Kitsune can link foxfire to a target, using its spiritual density as a floating pivot to push, lift, or guide the object remotely. Cataclysm can cause rapid micro rupture in air to use their shockwaves to direct the target objects anywhere they want.

objects.title: Thermal Generation
objects.text:
It allows your Major Gift to induce significant thermal energy, raising the temperature of yourself or nearby area. This may range from radiating intense warmth to producing concentrated combustion capable of igniting, scorching, or melting materials like a standard fire if your major gift allows for it.

Act of God can rapidly vibrate the invisible Aether medium surrounding an object generating extreme kinetic friction that causes targets to catch fire. With Bifröst, the residual light energy from your rainbow column leaves behind thermal aura.

objects.title: Thermal Deprivation
objects.text:
It grants your Major Gift the ability to rapidly siphon and dissipate thermal energy, instantly chilling yourself, target objects, or your surrounding environment. The sudden drop in temperature can eventually freeze liquids, induce thermal shock to weaken dense materials to make them vulnerable.

With Jormungandr, the supernatural darkness of your Black Tide absorbs surrounding ambient energy, causing the water to be ice cold. With Garden of Eden, you can force vegetation to wither into dust absorbing all surrounding heat to flash-freeze the area.

objects.title: Repulsion
objects.text:
It allows you to project your Major Gift's core principles outward, forcefully launching targets up to 250 kg away from you. Objects are driven away at violent speeds, generating enough raw momentum to overturn light vehicles, shatter barricades, or hurl incoming attackers backward.

Curtain call manifests this as 'exit' removing things from the stage set up by you. With Seraphim, a blinding pulse of celestial light erupts from your wings, generating a wave of divine pressure that hurls charging opponents backward.

objects.title: Attraction
objects.text:
It allows you to project your Major Gift's underlying mechanics across a 30-meter radius to lock onto objects up to 250 kg and forcefully draw them toward your position. The acceleration is swift and forceful, generating enough kinetic momentum to yank heavy vehicles out of their position.

With Martial Law, your established jurisdiction treats targeted objects as "contraband," forcing it to accelerate straight toward your hands under law. Hemomancy lets you control drops of blood on the objects to forcefully bring it towards you.

objects.title: Concealment
objects.text:
It grants you the ability to suppress your physical presence, making yourself difficult to sense and track. By muting the signals your body naturally produces, you can slip past active perception to evade detection. It does not make you completely undetectable for careful inspections but for making escape.

With Calculus, you differentiate the visual boundaries between your body and the immediate environment, blending into environment like chameleon. With Frame Drop, you force local reality to skip "rendering" you out of visual perception of others.

objects.title: Projection
objects.text:
It allows you to express your ability across long distances, releasing its properties outward as directed beams or ranged environmental disruptions. Rather than requiring immediate proximity, It allows you to translate your power into some long-range energy based application under its theme.

With Garden of Eden, your plants can rapidly focus sunlight, before unleashing a concentrated solar beam. With Chekov's gun you may destroy a marble to convert its 25% of its mass into energy balls that you can throw at your enemies.

objects.title: Psychics
objects.text:
It grants your power an avenue to perceive or alter minds through its thematic medium. Unlike absolute mind control, this manifests as specialized utility: either allowing you to intercept surface thoughts and emotional states or project subtle suggestions and cognitive disruptions into a target's mind.

With Vacancy, you can project an "absence" directly into a target's mind, creating a brief cognitive blind spot that causes them to forget what they were doing. With Möbius Strip, you can loop a target's current train of thought into a self-contained cycle temporarily.

objects.title: Recovery
objects.text:
It grants you the ability to rapidly mend minor physical injuries and biological trauma by harnessing your power's medium externally or channeling it internally. While initial recovery is rapid, subsequent uses in rapid succession drops the healing speed, making it unreliable for prolonged combat.

With Dead Air, you can inhale nearby smoke, causing the floating carbon particles to integrate with you to patch rebuild open wounds. With Blindspot, you may shift into superposition state before collapsing back into reality as less damaged version.

rows.title: The Minor gifts
rows.titleText:
"A Major Gift is the heart of your power. It defines what you can do, and the limits that bind you to it. It is powerful but rather stubborn about what it is."

Minor Gifts offer secondary abilities that integrate into your major gift. A Minor Gift will never outshine a Major Gift built on the same concept

Though it will amplify any Major Gift that shares its traits in those specific areas only.

[Choose 3]

objects.title: Monologuist
objects.text:
Whenever you become confident in your own victory, you will feel an increasingly powerful urge to stop and monologue. You may begin describing the brilliance of your strategy or start revealing information you would normally keep secret just to gloat.

This compulsion only manifests when fighting ordinary people or opponents you believe you have decisively outmatched. Once the monologue begins, however, interrupting yourself before you've finished becomes considerably more difficult.

objects.title: Reckless Bravado
objects.text:
Caution is stripped from your mind the moment a crisis begins. When danger presents itself, your instincts push you toward the boldest, most dangerous and unnecessarily dramatic solution available, such as breaking through walls rather than using doors.

You are not suicidal, nor are you incapable of understanding danger. You simply possess an absurd confidence that you can handle it, and that instinct tends to overpower your common sense, Still you look extremely cool while doing these things.

objects.title: Fan service
objects.text:
As much as I personally hate this one, The narrative has apparently decided that the cast needed a little fanservice. You now possess an instinctive tendency to behave in a seductive, charming and attention-grabbing manner, deliberately or otherwise.

You develop an instinct to draw attention of people and audience towards yourself and use flirtation and allure to keep it on yourself. When an opportunity presents itself, you may find yourself instinctively exploiting your sexuality to get what you want.

objects.title: Mystery
objects.text:
You develop an instinctive reluctance to provide straightforward explanations for your actions, particularly when doing so would ruin your mystique. When asked about anything, you may respond with a vague reply or a knowing smirk.

You can explain yourself normally when absolutely necessary, but whenever there is an opportunity to preserve your mystique, the Narrative practically begs you to take it. After all, "You'll understand soon enough" sounds much cooler than actually explaining the plan.

objects.title: Tsundere
objects.text:
You are cursed with a fiercely defensive pride that forces you to mask genuine concern, vulnerability, or affection behind sharp hostility or stubborn denial. You are driven to immediately undercut any positive actions or compliment towards you.

While it makes you annoying to deal with, When forced into a corner and defending someone you vehemently deny caring about, your stubbornness triggers a sudden surge of physical enhancements to grant you the strength to save them.

objects.title: The Bleeding Heart
objects.text:
You cannot bring yourself to believe that anyone is truly beyond saving. You genuinely want to save the crying child you imagine still hiding inside every monster, and abandoning them to their own darkness is far more crueler than death.

You deliver heartfelt speeches to enemies in the hope of reaching them. It can even put you and those around you in danger. Yet your sincerity is difficult to truly dislike. People may find your idealism exhausting, but they will struggle to hate you and your kindness.

objects.title: Non CHalant
objects.text:
You simply do not take things as seriously as you should. No matter how dangerous a situation becomes, your instinct is to remain relaxed, crack jokes, or treat the whole affair like an inconvenience, struggling to recognize when something deserves your full attention.

You can make poor decisions because you assume everything will work itself out, annoy people who desperately need you to take them seriously, and occasionally allow situations to escalate simply because you couldn't be bothered

objects.title: Comedic Relief
objects.text:
The cosmic stage treats you as its personal punchline. You are magnetically drawn to absurd, embarrassing events. Slipping on banana peels or falling through weak roof tiles during a tense stealth operation are routine occurrences for you.

The universe balances your absurd misfortune by granting you uncanny resilience against comedic harm. You can survive falling from ridiculous heights and stand up again, getting blasted in the face leaves you with mere soot left remaining afterwards.

objects.title: Spotlight
objects.text:
Your existence is a magnet for public attention, crazy stalkers and relentless paparazzi. Whether through stray drone cameras, observant bystanders, or obsessed journalists, every move you make in your other persona is tracked, recorded, and scrutinized.

No matter how quiet a covert operation or personal rescue mission is supposed to be, the universe conspires to put a lens on you and alert everyone of your presence. You do develop a sense for when you're being watched however.

objects.title: Soap Opera
objects.text:
You are driven by an melancholic impulse to isolate yourself and hide into dark corners, rooftops, or shadows to ponder your heavy fate. You treat genuine offers of friendship with cynicism, Fully convinced that pushing allies away is the only way to protect them.

You feel a subconscious pull to keep devastating secrets buried within yourself, withhold vital information from your allies “for their own good,” and shoulder every burden alone. While such sacrifice may sound noble in a story, in practice, its very stupid.

objects.title: Bad Timing
objects.text:
You possess an atrocious temporal luck, you are guaranteed to walk into a room at the exact second a completely innocent situation looks horribly incriminating, or miss a crucial briefing because a freak accident delayed you by two minutes.

Worse still, authority figures, allies, enemies or romantic interests will consistently barge through your door at the absolute worst possible moment for perfect misunderstandings and forces you to waste valuable time clearing your name over pure accidents.

objects.title: Worf Effect
objects.text:
You are deemed the Measuring stick used by the plot to show the power and danger of up and coming threats and antagonists alike. As a result you are bound to be involved in conflict whenever it arises and make the opposition look powerful.

As a result of this you will often find yourself fighting battles that have the odds going against you winning. This doesn´t guarantee you lose, it often will not even sabotage you, but the new big threat cannot go losing their first fight so soon now, can they?

rows.title: The Burdens
rows.titleText:
"The world is your stage, the cosmos your audience, and power is the script you are bound to perform. Yet, no grand actor takes the spotlight without cost"

These are your Burdens. They are the little pieces of fiction that have begun bleeding into your life.

They may manifest as instincts and compulsions to behave exactly as the audience would expect.

You are granted the stage, the spotlight, and the power to break reality but you must play the role you have been written.

[You can control these urges but cannot every outright remove them, Pick ]

objects.title: The Law of Aptitude
objects.text: You possess an instinctive competence with your Signature Item. The moment you acquire it, you understand its physical behavior intuitively. You will immediately understand the obvious ways it can be handled and instinctively avoid many of the mistakes a novice would make. With practice, that instinct becomes the foundation for genuine mastery.

objects.title: The Law of Invocation
objects.text: Your item does not occupy space when left idle, it may enter the scene only when the script demands it. You do not need to awkwardly haul your item through everyday life or worry about where to conceal it, it can be summoned into your hands whenever you desire. You cannot rapidly dismiss and resummon it over and over again, It needs a 10 min cooldown.

objects.title: The Law of Return
objects.text: So long as your narrative endures, your item cannot be permanently severed from your story. It possesses a supernatural resilience that allows it to repair itself when damaged over time. Minor damage repairs quickly, generally within seconds or a few minutes but complete destruction of item can take a few hours to regenerate it once again.

objects.title: The Law of Medium
objects.text: A signature item never operates independently of your Major Gift, it is the lens through which your power can be focused. An item is not a separate tool with its own isolated abilities. Instead, it serves as the ultimate conductor for your Major Gift exclusively. The exact degree of and form of channeling can vary depending on the Item and the Gift itself.

rows.title: Signature Items: The Fundamentals
rows.titleText:
"Now, we simply cannot send our little star out onto the stage without a proper makeover, can we?

What on earth would the critics say if I allowed you to step into the grand spotlight in those dreadful... beggar's clothes?"

Heavens, no! That simply will not do. A true star needs a defining presence, a silhouette that demands complete, undivided attention.

Let us start small. Let us give you a genuine identity.. A personal relic? An expression of your very soul. Yes! A Signature Item made for you! But before we hand you your item, let me elaborate on the fundamental laws that every single item must strictly obey:

objects.title: Twin Gauntlets
objects.text:
A pair of enormous Stone gauntlets adorn your arms, each extending from your hands to just below the elbow. Despite their bulky appearance, they weigh almost nothing in your hands, allowing you to move, guard, punch, grapple, and fight without being dragged down by their size and weight.

Their signature trick is Last Hand. With a deliberate motion, you can launch the entire left gauntlet from your arm like a cannonball, sending it hurtling forward at tremendous speed covering 30m distance.

objects.title: Exclamation Mark
objects.text:
An absurdly oversized, double-headed war mallet. It is brutally effective for smashing through defenses, sending people flying, cracking concrete, and generally solving problems through the ancient art of hitting them really f*cking hard.

Its little trick is Pocket Size. With the press of a small button built into the handle, the hammer compresses itself down to a tiny size, small enough to fit into your pockets. And when the button is pressed again, it rapidly expands back to its full ridiculous size.

objects.title: Knuckle Dusters
objects.text:
A pair of heavy brass knuckle-dusters designed to sit tightly around your fists. They offer perhaps the shortest effective range, but what they lack in reach they make up for by making every punch count.

Their defining property is Numb Knuckles. Any pain, impact, or physical backlash caused by a strike you deliver through the dusters simply does not register to you, You can punch diamonds without any consequences or pain. The dusters themselves are also among the hardest artifacts in existence.

objects.title: Demolisher
objects.text:
A massive iron wrecking ball attached to long, heavy-duty whip. The ball weighs roughly three tons, yet the weight is remarkably manageable in your hands. You can swing it, drag it, or launch it with tremendous force capable of smashing through concrete.

The whip has no fixed maximum length. It can extend as far as you can genuinely force it to, provided you have the strength and will to keep driving the ball outward. The farther you push it, the more physical effort is required and control degrades as well.

objects.title: Buddhist Beads
objects.text:
A strand of 25 small Buddhist prayer beads worn loosely around one hand, light enough to never interfere with movement. With a quick snap of your arm, you can decouple and launch individual beads like high-velocity kinetic slugs up to 50 meters away.

Once fired, each bead requires a full sixty seconds to recharge its spiritual tether before flying back into the wristband. This prevents reckless spamming and forces strategic planning but even then these beads rival shotgun rounds in sheer momentum.

objects.title: Opal Bow
objects.text:
A massive bow fashioned from brilliant opal and polished ceramic. Despite its size, it is remarkably comfortable to wield, and the bow itself can serve as a surprisingly effective melee weapon when necessary but is prone to breaking easily under impacts.

The bow carries no quiver. When you pull back the string, your will conjures a solid, needle-sharp arrow of condensed light directly onto the nock. Fired at tremendous velocity, these light-arrows behave like standard steel-tipped armor-piercing shafts.

objects.title: Crosshair
objects.text:
A heavy, matte-black firearm with sleek crimson accents along the slide and an open-air cylinder. Built with zero dependence on traditional brass gunpowder cartridges, it compresses atmospheric air directly into its own ammunition when needed.

It normally maintains six emergency rounds within an internal reserve, allowing you to fire even in unfavorable environments. Its strangest property is Ricochet. Every round fired can naturally rebound once making all sorts of tricks possible.

objects.title: Yo-Yo
objects.text:
A seemingly innocent children's toy, The yo-yo is delicate compared to most Signature Items, but its supernatural string can extend to 30 metres without losing its strength, making it useful for grappling, pulling, swinging and catching yourself.

The faster you force the yo-yo to rotate, the more static electricity its body generates. At maximum practical speed it can become hot enough to scorch human skin or act as a taser even. Stopping the spin however instantly kills the charge buildup.

objects.title: Chakrams
objects.text:
A pair of flaming metallic chakrams, each ring large enough to be wielded comfortably in one hand. Their edges are honed to an almost absurd sharpness, allowing them to carve through wood with ease, excellent for close combat.

They are built to be thrown, Each chakram naturally curves back toward its wielder, returning to your hands after its flight much like a boomerang, allowing you to repeatedly throw and recover them without needing to chase your own weapons.

objects.title: Quickblade
objects.text:
A beautifully made blade with a sharp edge, a strong body, and excellent balance. It is light enough to move quickly, sturdy enough to withstand serious combat, and naturally suited to fast, precise close-range fighting and defensive maneuvers.

Its special quality is almost insulting in its simplicity: it is exceptionally good at being a sword. This grants it the fastest raw draw, swing, and parry speed of any short-range weapon in the entire catalog, allowing you to straight up slice through hail of bullets if needed.

objects.title: Harvester
objects.text:
A scythe forged from a dark metal, its long curved edge is unnaturally cold. The blade is razor-sharp, capable of cutting cleanly through wood and other ordinary materials with little resistance. Its long handle and sweeping arc make it particularly effective at controlling the space around its wielder.

Its trick is Jumpscare. With a deliberate command, A second blade unclasps from the base of the shaft and locks rigidly into place, converting the single weapon into an aggressive dual-headed scythe.

objects.title: Whip Blade
objects.text:
A simple dagger with a rather simple edge by the standards of the other Signature Items. It can still seriously injure a person, but lacks the sharpness to cleanly cut through wood. Pressing a button along the hilt changes that entirely however.

The blade splits apart along its hidden layers, each segment separating from the next before electromagnetic forces snap them together into a flexible chain. In this form, the dagger becomes a segmented whip capable of extending up to 20 meters.

objects.title: War Fans
objects.text:
A pair of broad war fans constructed from overlapping plates of durable metal, each one folding neatly into a compact baton when closed. Opened, they provide excellent defensive coverage and can be wielded used to block, strike and redirect attacks.

Their trick is Fan Step. When both fans are opened and snapped downward with enough force, it can briefly create a solid foothold in the air beneath you, it lasts only a moment, but it is enough to change direction or jump again in midair.

objects.title: Mary Poppins
objects.text:
A sleek, elegant umbrella featuring a classic design and a subtle, customized geometric pattern woven across its canopy. When closed, the reinforced spine functions as fighting quarterstaff for rapid parries, lunges, and blunt strikes.

Its trick is Air Hook. By thrusting the tip of the closed umbrella into open air at precisely the right angle, you can hook it into there as though there were an invisible solid surface there, letting you to hang from it or use it as an improvised aerial foothold.

objects.title: Bubble Shield
objects.text:
A circular shield formed from a translucent, energy, with a smooth surface that seems almost weightless despite its impressive resilience. It can block most conventional blows and projectiles, and many unconventional ones as well.

Its rounded edges are made from an unusually elastic material, allowing the shield to be thrown like a disc. Once released, it ricochets rapidly between surfaces at great velocities before naturally curving back toward you and safely stopping in your arms.

objects.title: Monkey’s Reach
objects.text:
A slender, elegant staff with the appearance of polished dark wood, though its material is far more resilient than its appearance suggests. Its simple construction encourages precise strikes, parries, sweeps, and disarming rather than brute-force.

The cane can extend from one end upto 45 meters in a fraction of a second. This makes it an exceptional tool for vaulting onto high rooftops or sneak attacks. It is the definitive tool of disciplined warriors and powerhouses who prefer to nerf themselves.

rows.title: Signature Items: The Selection
rows.titleText:
"Now, now... it is finally time for my star to claim their very own item. A fabulous, defining addition to the persona yet to come!"

One peculiar truth of this theatrical realm is that your Signature Item remains bound to you even when the grand curtains are drawn. While the vast majority of your extraordinary powers fail to manifest outside your super persona, this singular relic can still be summoned and wielded in your everyday form and channel a fraction of those powers regardless, Making you and your relation to your tool far more intimate. So, tell me... what grand artifact shall you make your signature?

objects.title: Telekinetic Draw
objects.text:
Should your Signature Item be far from you, you may command it to fly directly back into your hands without needing to resummon it. Once called, it travels at speeds faster than a bullet, and you have complete control over its return path.

You can send it along a straight line to ram through obstacles, or weave it through curved paths to avoid allies and other obstacles. A discarded weapon just as dangerous as one already in your hands.

objects.title: False Profile
objects.text:
Your Signature Item can disguise itself as an ordinary mundane object. Once disguised, it is completely normal and can be carried around, passing casual observation without drawing attention.

The shape it takes is guided by the general profile of the weapon: a blade might contract into a pen, a shield into a fidget spinner, or a staff into a walking cane. You can dismiss the disguise at any time, instantly restoring the item to its true form mid-draw.

objects.title: Binary Split
objects.text:
Your Signature Item can split into two identical copies, each reduced to 50% of the original item's size. Both halves retain the item's normal properties and can be wielded independently. The split can be maintained for as long as you concentrate on keeping it active.

You can freely merge and divide the weapon mid-combat to rapidly shift between a single and a dual-wield style, if your concentration slips, they both immediately reunite into one tool again.

objects.title: Injection
objects.text:
A Vocal command to your Signature Item activates injection of a supernatural liquid metal into hollow spaces within the item, where it rapidly solidifies and physically increases the weapon's mass by approximately 2 tons.

The mass persists for several minutes before disappearing. The added weight is physically real, allowing you to deliver crushing blows, or immobilize opponents pinned beneath it.

objects.title: Ballistic Throw
objects.text: You can spin your Signature Item to build up an absurd amount of momentum, allowing you to throw it at sniper-like velocities. Once released, the weapon tears through whatever lies in its path with the force of its speed, potentially punching through buildings before eventually coming to a stop after sometime. As powerful as this trick is, This will make your tool unavailable for you for the distance it covered is vast and even re-summoning it may take 10 minutes.

objects.title: Overgrowth
objects.text:
At will, your Signature Item can increase its length and overall size by up to five times. The enlargement occurs during a swing or immediately before a strike, and lasts until that particular swing is completed.

The weapon retains its original weight while enlarged, but the sudden expansion drastically increases its reach and physical leverage. The weapon's kinetic momentum scales directly with the enlarged arc, making it more devastating than a standard hit.

objects.title: Ghost Form
objects.text:
At will, your Signature Item can temporarily become intangible to everything except your own hands. For several seconds, it can pass freely through solid matter while remaining perfectly usable by you.

This allows you to swing through walls, barriers or other obstacles, as well as perform convincing fake-outs by making the weapon appear to pass harmlessly through an opponent. Once the effect ends, it requires 1 minute before it can be activated again.

objects.title: Position Swap
objects.text:
By clapping your hands, you can instantly swap locations with your Signature Item, regardless of where it currently is. The exchange produces a sudden puff of smoke at both locations, briefly obscuring both you and the weapon as the teleportation occurs, providing immediate tactical cover for you.

Due to the high energy strain of such spatial displacement, this ability requires a 5-minute cooldown between each teleportation.

rows.title: Signature Items: The Addition
rows.titleText:
"Ah, but wait! What is a masterpiece without the artist’s own mad little brushstroke?"

So step right up to the anvil of vanity! You may grant your item one additional perk, a customised ability designed specifically around how you fight, and move.

Your Signature Item is already extraordinary. But every star needs something that makes them unmistakably theirs.

[Choose 1]

objects.title: The Persona
objects.text:
Your Persona is the transformation granted to those blessed by the Narrative, the form in which an ordinary person becomes an Actor upon the world's stage. It is more than a costume and more than a mere disguise. It is the version of you that belongs beneath the spotlight.

A Persona isn't a mask you wear to hide your face; it is the ultimate unmasking of you. A Persona is your most uninhibited form, a physical manifestation of your absolute inner truth. It doesn't care whether it manifests as a terrifying, heroic, or something outrageous, its design is forged directly from the depths of your subconscious: your buried impulses, your ambitions, and your raw desire to be seen.

The Signature Item can still channel a fraction of your power while you remain untransformed, but that is only a taste of what the real Actor can do. While in Persona, your supernatural abilities can be unleashed in their true form and can be freely used by you. As such, Persona is the standard form to assume when in combat with another or other danger.

objects.title: The EGo
objects.text:
The Narrative chooses people who are interesting. But being interesting is not enough to become an Actor. The world is full of fascinating people. You can throw a stone down any crowded street and hit someone interesting.

But being interesting isn't enough to earn a role. Most people, no matter how extraordinary, are still content to sit in the audience and let the world happen to them. They accept what they cannot change and live within the limits of the world around them.

An Actor is different. What matters is their ego. It does not care whether you want to save everyone, destroy everything or build something beautiful, What matters is your sheer arrogance to alter the world to your liking.

Your supernatural abilities are your Ego being imposed upon the world so forcefully that the world has no choice but to accommodate it. It is the sheer, terrible arrogance of humanity that paved over the ancient wilderness and built cities out of dust only to reduce it back by splitting atoms.

objects.title: Snap
objects.text: A simple finger snap is all it takes. Except yours is anything but simple. The sound erupts with enough force to be heard clearly within roughly 50 metres, followed by a brilliant white flash that briefly fills the area. When the light disappears, your civilian self is gone and your Persona is standing in their place.

objects.title: Phrase
objects.text: Your Persona has a phrase of their own, something you must speak aloud to invoke them. It might be a declaration, a chant or something only you understand. As you speak it, your voice begins to echo unnaturally through the surrounding area and your persona overtakes your body as the phrase ends.

objects.title: Masking
objects.text: You must hide your face before the transformation can begin. The second your features are completely hidden from the gaze of the crowd, the world loses its grip on your identity and the shadows overtake your body and your persona stands. For as long as your identity remains hidden, the transformation is active.

objects.title: Whistle
objects.text: Whistling a eerie, distinct tune distorts ambient noise, carrying the sound much farther than it should, lingering through the area with an eerie, almost unnatural quality. People may hear the tune before they ever see you. Once the final note ends, your Persona arrives from within you.

objects.title: Blood
objects.text: Your transformation is bought and paid for in crimson. . You must deliberately draw your own, using your hand or another suitable means, while genuinely intending to accomplish something with the Persona you are calling forth. The moment that first drop of blood breaks the skin or hits the floor, your Ego overtakes you.

objects.title: TRIGGER OBJECT
objects.text: You possess a strange object specifically tied to your Persona. It might be a device, an artifact, a belt, a ring, or something else entirely. To transform, you must perform a specific sequence with it, combining, inserting, twisting or activating it in whatever unnecessarily extravagant fashion suits you.

objects.title: CONSUMPTION
objects.text: Your Persona is summoned by eating or drinking something edible thats specific in nature. Maybe it is an absurdly spicy piece of chicken. Maybe it is a chocolate shake. Maybe it is black coffee or a particular candy, Whatever it is, The moment the taste hits your tongue, your ego awakens to it and overtakes you.

objects.title: Dynamic Stance
objects.text: You have a specific, unconventional stance that must be hit properly and with confidence. It may be awkward to perform the first few times, but once you learn to own it, the pose becomes easier to pull off. Hit it with enough conviction and the ground explodes and from the dust cloud your Persona takes over.

rows.title: The Triggers
rows.titleText:
"Now, before we decide what your Persona looks like.. But how do you ring the bell?"

Every Actor has a Trigger, the specific action that allows them to cross from their ordinary self into their Persona.

Choose one that fits the image you want to build. After all, if people are going to watch you transform, you might as well give them something worth remembering.

objects.title: Costumed
objects.text: Your Persona keeps most of your original body but now dons a vibrant, high-contrast costume layered with striking geometric patterns, and bold, memorable motifs that look as though they were torn straight from a comic book page. This form manifests from an Ego fed by public spectacle, pop culture, and an desire to be center of attention and glory.

objects.title: Colossus
objects.text: Your Persona takes on a towering and powerful frame, standing at least eight feet tall with broad shoulders and defined muscles. The clothing shifts into tight, heavy-duty wraps, worn leather jackets, or broad metallic chest plates. This form comes from an Ego that wants its strength to be visible before it is ever demonstrated. You want to be taken seriously.

objects.title: Noir
objects.text: Your persona Takes on a lean, Slim build with an air of mystery around it alongside minor changes like devil tail or white pale skin. The clothing associated tends towards dark, flowing and practical styles. This form springs from an Ego that thrives on the thrill of mystery, observation, and total information control. It reflects a mind that views life as a game of chess.

objects.title: Suited
objects.text: Your Persona is dressed in some form of formal wear, whether it is a pristine black suit, a three-piece ensemble, an extravagant colored suit, a long coat accompanied by supernatural masks covering your face, glowing eyes or Devil horns. This form springs from an Ego rooted in supreme self-assurance, charm, and pride in one's own capabilities.

objects.title: Mechanical
objects.text: Your Persona becomes partly or entirely artificial, replacing flesh with machinery, synthetic materials to achieve a constructed body. Your form may look sleek and futuristic, industrial and heavy or clockwork and antique. This form comes from an Ego fascinated by creation and improvement, erecting an unyielding iron sanctuary to improve their own body.

objects.title: EXO-SHELL
objects.text: Your Persona becomes completely sealed within a sleek, full-body suit of reinforced combat armor. The armour can be sleek and aerodynamic, heavy and imposing or elegant and ceremonial. This form springs from an Ego that views itself as an absolute, incorruptible instrument of purpose, utterly unwavering in their resolve to achieve their goal.

objects.title: Animated
objects.text: Your Persona takes on an exaggerated, cartoon-like appearance that openly ignores the proportions and aesthetics of ordinary human bodies. This form comes from an Ego that values expression, imagination and absurdity. The form allows you to embody the exaggerated version of yourself that you could never have realistically become.

objects.title: Monstrous
objects.text: Your Persona abandons the ordinary human shape and transforms into something far more unnatural with abnormal skin, elongated limbs, additional limbs, scales, fur, unnatural skin, or entirely new anatomy. This persona reflects a soul that embraces its wildness and internal dark impulses, refusing to hide its dangerous edge for comfort of others.

rows.title: The Appearance
rows.titleText:
"Once your Persona is invoked, your body is fundamentally altered to manifest your uninhibited ego into reality"

The final form is no longer quite the same body they started with.

Your height, build and even the basic shape of your body can all change depending on what your Persona represents.

[Choose the silhouette that best captures the silhouette your ego should have]

objects.title: The Bravado
objects.text:
Your Persona knows they are the sh*t, and they have absolutely no problem acting like it.

They carry themselves with an air of assurance and love doing things that make them look impressive. Even when they have absolutely no idea what they are doing, they have a remarkable talent for acting as though they absolutely do. They can bluff their way through situations simply through sheer confidence.

objects.title: The Untamed
objects.text: Your Persona is expressive, instinctive, and brutally honest about how they feel. If they like someone, they might hug them without thinking twice. If they are hungry, They will eat anything nearby. If somebody crosses a line, they may simply just punch them in the face. This is an Ego that has utterly discarded any and all societal masking, choosing to run on their pure, unfiltered human impulse and desire.

objects.title: the reserved
objects.text: Your Persona becomes practical, reserved, and noticeably quieter than you normally are. They can come across as distant or even slightly annoyed by the sheer existence of other people, but that does not mean they are heartless. They care deeply for their friends but most of the time, they would rather be left alone to do what they came here to do than make acquaintances with everyone else.

objects.title: The Romantic
objects.text: Your Persona sees life as something worth experiencing intensely. They are emotionally expressive and unafraid of sincerity. They can admire someone openly, become genuinely excited about meeting a new person, or throw themselves wholeheartedly into something simply because it feels meaningful. Your Ego rejects a world that tells you to be cynical settling for a beautiful view instead.

objects.title: The Harlequin
objects.text: Your Persona approaches almost everything with a sense of fun. Teasing enemies while in combat or find something to poke fun at even in dangerous situations. They are not necessarily careless or immature. They simply refuse to let the seriousness of a situation completely dictate how they behave. Even when things become dangerous, they would rather face them with a grin than allow fear to take control.

objects.title: The Explorer
objects.text:
Your Persona wants to experience everything. They want to see places they have never seen, meet new people, discover new secrets, and wake up wondering what that day might bring along.

Routine becomes suffocating once the Persona is free to choose. They do not necessarily have some grand destination in mind. The journey itself is the point and the experience gained is the treasure.

objects.title: The Hedonist
objects.text: Your Persona lives for the intoxicating, uninhibited rush of the absolute present. It has long stopped feeling guilty about wanting to enjoy life. Whatever makes them happy, they pursue it without any shame. You don't linger on yesterday's mistakes, nor do you waste time hand-wringing over tomorrow's consequences. They simply refuse to treat their own suffering as inherently virtuous anymore.

objects.title: The Lionheart
objects.text: An ego that is bound to their conviction: If you are blessed with power, you bloody well use it to protect those who don't have it. What matters is that they cannot watch someone being hurt when they know they could have done something. This springs from an Ego that craves the ultimate high of being the rock upon which the ocean breaks and that despises watching the innocents get trampled by a cruel world.

rows.title: The Personality
rows.titleText:
"Once transformed, the version of you that steps onto the stage may act very differently from the person you are in your ordinary life"

Your Persona is not bound by all the same hesitations, insecurities, social expectations, or self-control that hold you back as a civilian.

It is still you, but it is you without the leash you have.

It may be who you wish you were. It may be who you think you should be.

[Choose the Personality]

objects.title: Mild Influence
objects.text:
You remain firmly at the center of your own mind with Persona having very little control over you. You remain firmly in charge of your body and decisions, with your Persona mostly expressing itself through impulses, thoughts, emotional reactions, and occasional suggestions. You may suddenly find yourself wanting to behave differently, speak differently, or do something your ordinary self normally would not.

But ultimately, you decide how you act.

objects.title: Equal Control
objects.text: You and your Persona operate in total, synchronized harmony. Your civilian self and your uninhibited Ego sit in the driver's seat side-by-side, sharing a unified perspective. You and your Persona have roughly equal influence over what you do and feel. Sometimes your ordinary self takes the lead. Sometimes your Persona does. The strangest part is that neither of you is truly subordinate to the other, because neither of you is truly separate from the other either.

objects.title: The Pendulum
objects.text: The boundary between you and persona is never fixed, constantly ebbing and flowing based on the friction of the moment. Control shifts between you and your Persona depending on certain conditions. Perhaps your Persona takes over when you are angry. Perhaps you become dominant when you are calm. Maybe fear gives your Persona control, while protecting someone you care about brings you back. Neither of you is always in charge for long however.

objects.title: Full Possession
objects.text: The second your transformation initiates, your civilian self is relegated to a passive observer locked behind your own eyes. Your unrestrained Ego takes total, unyielding control of your body, speech, and power, executing its deepest desires with complete autonomy. You watch the performance unfold as a bystander caged within your own mind, only regaining physical agency when the Persona is finally satisfied with its work and recedes back into you.

rows.title: Persona Influence
rows.titleText:
"When the stage lights ignite and the transformation takes hold, you do not vanish.. nor do you simply step aside."

Your Persona is you, but it is not quite the same you.

How much of your ordinary consciousness remains in the driver's seat and how much you surrender to the raw momentum of your Ego defines the boundary between holding the mask and letting the mask wear you.

[How much influence your persona truly holds over you?]

objects.title: Love
objects.text: You love being your Persona because being them feels right. You love their appearance, their personality, their mannerisms, and the way the world feels when you inhabit their skin. You may find yourself looking forward to every transformation, savouring the little things about being them that nobody else would ever understand. You might even feel a quiet ache when it is time to return to your ordinary life again.

objects.title: Resentment
objects.text: You refuse to accept your Persona as a reflection of yourself. Whatever they represent, you want no part of it. Perhaps you see them as a distortion of your identity, a cruel caricature of your flaws you desperately hide or a sick reminder of your own failings, You may even find yourself hating them for making everything look so easy while you struggled with it for years, as if mocking you for it.

objects.title: Indifference
objects.text: You do not have particularly strong feelings about your Persona. You do not need to worship them for their strengths or despise them for their shortcomings. You acknowledge the connection between you, but you do not feel any special attachment to the person you become, Simply treating the transformation as a means to an end. A necessary step you must undertake to fully access your abilities.

rows.title: Persona Relationship
rows.titleText:
"Just because they are made from your ego, that does not mean you will like what you find."

You may share a body with your Persona, but you do not have to share their feelings about who you are.

After all, discovering who you are and accepting who you are can be two very different things.

[So, when you look at the person you become, what do you feel?]

objects.title: Blue star
objects.text:
Blue stars are among the most brilliant stars in the heavens. Their intense heat and luminosity come at a cost, however, as they consume their fuel at a tremendous rate and live comparatively short lives.

Your Ego burns with intensity, producing a Persona that is more powerful than those sustained by the other two types. You can remain in Persona for approximately 2 hours before your Ego is exhausted and requires a recharge duration of upto 4 hours.

(Use : Refill Ratio: 1 : 2)

objects.title: Yellow star
objects.text:
Yellow stars occupy a comfortable middle ground. They burn with considerable intensity while maintaining the stability needed to endure for billions of years. Your ego possesses enough intensity to sustain a powerful Persona without consuming its reserves too quickly, allowing you use your abilities without constantly watching the clock. You can remain transformed for 8 hours before exhausting your reserve, replenishing the entire reserve takes approximately 12 hours.

(Use : Refill Ratio: 2 : 3)

objects.title: Red star
objects.text:
Red stars burn at lower temperatures than the rest, consuming their fuel more slowly. Many can remain active for extraordinary lengths of time, outliving most of their fellow stars by a vast margin. Your Persona is somewhat weaker than those prodcued by Blue stars, but your reserve lasts considerably longer, allowing you to remain transformed upto higher ceiling of a full 24 hours, While replenishing the reserves from an empty tank also takes 24 hours as well.

(Use : Refill Ratio: 1 : 1)

rows.title: Ego Burnout
rows.titleText:
"Your Persona exists because your Ego can sustain it, But even human ego has its limit"

Remaining transformed constantly slowly exhausts the ego that sustains the Persona. Eventually, your connection weakens and the transformation collapses.

Every Actor has a different capacity for sustaining their Persona.

[Choose how your Ego handles the strain]

objects.title: Villain
objects.text:
You claim the side that dictates the tempo of the performance, The force that strikes first, sets the terms, and forces reality to react to your whim. But the Stage is a bitter director, and it stacks the narrative deck against those who play the antagonist. Living openly becomes difficult. You may have to work from the shadows, keep your true intentions hidden, or accept the virtue of patience in your master plans.

Villains are meant to be opposed. Eventually, the story will arrange for a Hero to challenge you and disrupt your plans, and when that happens, The one with more resolve shall win the fight.

objects.title: Hero
objects.text:
You choose the side of the story the crowd longs to cheer for. They are the shining faces of the Narrative, its symbols of hope, courage, and everything worth protecting. Walking this path grants you the camaraderie of like-minded actors, and a life lived under the open sky rather than in the shadows. But by the ancient laws of the Stage, a hero is inherently reactive. You do not get to dictate the flow of conflict.

That is the cruelest part of being a Hero.

You can save the day, again and again and again, and still be unable to save the dawn of a new day itself.

rows.title: Persona Path
rows.titleText:
"Every story has sides, So does this one."

In the grand architecture of the supernatural world, your Persona cannot exist in a vacuum. Reality itself forces you into a narrative alignment.

To walk the Stage is to accept a role in a perpetual, dramatic clash.. whether as the pillar that holds the falling ceiling or the tempest that brings it down.

It does not dictate your morality, nor does it determine what kind of person you must be. A Hero can be cruel. A Villain can be compassionate.

The Narrative is not particularly concerned with whether its actors are good people.

It solely cares about the role they play.

Point-types can be made in Features then Manage Points. Hovering over buttons will explain what they do. The Design of the project can be changed in 'Modify Design' at the side navigation bar, and private styling for each row can be turned on in the rows Settings. backpack.title: Your Upbringing
backpack.titleText:
Every star begins somewhere.

There was a home, a family, and a life quietly shaping the person you would become. Whether your roots were nurturing or cruel, humble or privileged, they still cling to you today.

Where did your story take root?

backpack.title: Something About You
backpack.titleText:
Before the world handed you a Role, before the spotlight ever found your name, you were simply... you.

Your habits, passions, reputation, and quirks all helped shape the actor who now stands upon the world's grandest stage.

Who were you?

backpack.title: Your Defining Traits
backpack.titleText:
Every unforgettable character is remembered for something.

virtue that inspired millions. A flaw that brought everything crashing down. Traits that makes you interesting and worthwhile to watch!

Which traits will the audience cheer for... and which will they wait to see betray you?
